NAME: Whiskey
TEXT: Cats, birds, dogs, you name it, Whiskey treats everyone big and small as a friend. Sweet boy Whiskey currently lives with cats and small dogs & is a very social & affectionate boy with people. He's also friendly with birds in a cage (see photo). He is soft and gentle around all of GAP's cats, small dogs and greyhounds making him a great addition to a multi-pet household with proper introductions conducted. Whiskey is very affectionate, calm and an all round lovely boy who we can see fitting in to a home with or without children. He has been learning how to be inside the house and is so far going great! He is learning to walk calmly on the lead and someone who can walk a strong dog is his best fit. Reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre to meet Whiskey.

NAME: Julie
TEXT: Miss Julie is a playful, friendly girl who loves her toys, a run around with the other dogs (retired greyhounds and Jug), a splash in her clam shell pool and just being around people and quiet kids 10+, not too rambunctious. She's a bit of a character, loves to show off but she's not over the top, just a happy girl! At 6 she hasn't lost energy but slows down faster and rests longer, especially as she is learning the comforts of retired life! Julie has grown up on the farm and has come into town life ready for her new home. She has taken to a nice cosy bed on the floor and loves being on the patio as well on the warm nights. She would suit a quiet household, and someone with the time to get to know her, take her for a walk and have a bit of playtime in the morning, especially if you are going off to work. Some toys, an outdoor bed, pool, sandpit or another dog friend will keep her company for the day, plus plenty of rests. Someone home more often than not would be perfect. She's easy going and not worried by pet birds, cats or little fluffy dogs. Just a sweetheart ready to relish retired life. 💗

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Goose is, well, just a big goose! Only 32 kg, gentle and loves attention. He likes to wander around the sheds with his owner and visits the farm border collie who he loves to play with. He's a good traveller, no house experience, but was walked in town as a puppy. He's used to pottering about, but dreams of finding that comfy couch or spot in the garden, patio or verandah. He's friendly and happy to meet new people with a wag of his tail, loves a swim in the dam and loves his toys. He has been around kids 10+, and when you're not around to follow about, he is happy to amuse himself throwing his toys up in the air, especially his beloved soccer ball. Goose is a gentle, happy-go-lucky boy who would make a wonderful, loyal and easy going companion. Goose doesn't bark, except occasionally as a reminder for a bit of attention if you've stopped patting or when its dinner time! He lost 2 toes on his back left foot due to an injury as a puppy, which doesn't bother him, otherwise a healthy lad who has so much love to give. 💙

NAME: Yola
TEXT: Yola thrives on social interaction. She's a dynamo, always up for fun, whether it's dashing about or bursting into a sudden sprint. With her angelic demeanor and captivating eyes, she can charm her way out of any mischief she finds herself in. Yola would suit someone who is after a companion to cruise around with day-to-day but also chill out on the couch with.

NAME: Paton
TEXT: Meet Paton, a gentle soul with a heart full of love waiting to be shared. While he may initially appear shy, give him a little time, and you'll discover a warm, affectionate side eager to form a deep bond. Paton flourishes when offered a nurturing environment where patience and kindness are the norms. Once you get to know him, you'll be rewarded with unwavering loyalty and affection. Beyond his loving demeanor, Paton enjoys every moment spent with his humans and takes particular delight in quiet moments together. For those seeking a companion with a nurturing and gentle personality, Paton is ready to fill your days with warmth and love. All he needs is a caring family to call his own.

NAME: Hope
TEXT: We hope that you’ll fall in love when you first lay eyes on our beautiful girl, Hope! Hope is a sweet, confident and gentle girl. She enjoys going for walks, walks lovely on the leash, and is beautiful around kids 5-10 years old. A home with respectable children would be suited. This happy vibrant girl is great with other medium to large dogs as well. If you can’t bear the idea of not having Hope in your life then apply to adopt her today!

NAME: Faith
TEXT: Given up on finding the perfect dog? Have a little faith! This happy excitable girl can't wait to bounce into your home! Faith is a good traveller, great in the car, friendly with people and dogs, and is great on the lead. She's a social and confident girl looking for a family with a townhouse/backyard, respectful kids who will enjoy play time, and a family who will include her in family life including walks and outings. Who are we to mess with faith? Enquire or Apply to Adopt this darling girl from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dylan
TEXT: Meet Dylan—a true pocket rocket bursting with energy and enthusiasm for life! This fun-loving boy is always on the go, whether it’s heading out for a walk, sprinting around the yard in full zoomie mode, or playing endlessly with his favourite toys. Dylan thrives in a home that can match his pace and give him the physical and mental stimulation he craves. He’ll need an active household with a good-sized yard and experienced children who are confident around large, energetic dogs. While Dylan doesn’t show strong prey drive, he can be a bit too much for small breeds, so he’s best suited to homes with a robust, playful canine companion of similar size—pending a successful meet and greet. He’s a whirlwind of joy, curiosity, and excitement, and would make a wonderful addition to a family that embraces his zest for life and is ready for all the fun he brings

NAME: Raven
TEXT: If you've had your eye on adopting an adorable senior, this might be your perfect match! Raven is a happy little lady ready to take on the world with you. She has an adorable, bright and bubbly nature. She will smother you in pats and be all over you. She is wonderful with other greyhounds, showing off her gentle and polite nature. She loves leaning on people and getting cuddles but also has a lovely independent side. With not a speck of grey on her adorable face you'd have to do a double take to realise this sweet lady was a senior! She has an enormous amount of love to give and we know she will adore being a member of your family. Raven is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sally
TEXT: Say hello to Sally—the life of the party and a greyhound full of bounce, joy, and endless fun! This playful girl loves her toys, lives for a good zoomie session, and thrives in an environment where she can stretch her long legs and let loose. Sally would love a home with a spacious yard and an active lifestyle to match her energy. She isn’t suited to homes with small animals but she’s a great match for other greyhounds or larger breeds who enjoy a good play session, pending a successful meet and greet. Sally is also a total sweetheart with people and doesn’t hold back on affection. Whether it’s leaning into a cuddle, joining in on family activities, or bringing her toy over for a game, she makes every moment fun and full of love. If you're looking for a lively, loving companion who will keep you smiling and moving, Sally might just be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet Missy, a gentle and sensitive soul with a quiet nature and a heart full of love to give. She’s looking for a peaceful home where she can take her time to settle in and truly be herself. Missy thrives in calm environments and would prefer a home without other pets—unless it’s another greyhound who shares her relaxed vibe. A yard where she can lounge in the sun or potter about at her own pace would be her dream come true. Once Missy feels safe and comfortable, her secret playful side begins to shine. She has a soft, endearing way of engaging with her people, showing affection and gentle joy that makes every moment with her special. If you're patient, kind, and ready to welcome a sweet girl who just needs a bit of time to bloom, Missy could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Jake
TEXT: Jake is a polite boy who can walk up and down stairs here at our centre, and enjoys settling indoors, making him suitable to step paws into an apartment home. He has shown he doesn't mind being alone for a little while, making him suitable for some hours alone. Jake has a calm and polite personality, around dogs and people. He's currently working on becoming friends with smaller dogs which is looking promising. Check back for more updates! If you're looking for a calm and gentle boy, meet Jake, Jake is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy Bear
TEXT: Our chilled out Teddy-Bear is ready to find his toy box! This handsome and gentle boy would suit a home with respectful children, big or small dogs, and of course some teddies to keep him company. Not only is he fabulous around children, he's been learning to go on walks with the kids, and he's well known for being quite confident across the board in many new situations. He would make a wonderful family pet due to his charming and adaptable nature. Teddy Bear is available at Western Sydney's adoption centre.

NAME: Julia
TEXT: Meet Julia, a gentle and affectionate 5-year-old female Greyhound with a heart full of love. She’s incredibly loyal and enjoys being close to her people—her favorite pastime is following her owner around the yard while he mows the lawn, just to be near him. Julia has a calm and sweet temperament that makes her a joy to have around, and she’s always up for some quiet companionship or a relaxing stroll. Julia is well-socialized and polite on walks, getting along well with other dogs she meets along the way. However, she prefers not to be around smaller animals, so a home without cats or small pets would be best. She’d thrive in a family environment, especially one with a yard where she can stretch out and soak up the sun. If you’re looking for a loving, devoted companion, Julia might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Rambo
TEXT: Rambo is enjoying living in a foster home in inner Sydney. In just a few weeks Rambo has come out of his shell and shown himself to be an affectionate, playful, curious and silly boy. His favourite hobbies include napping on the floor, asking for cuddles (and cheese), and of course exploring the neighbourhood on his daily walks. Well-suited for apartment living, Rambo now has his ‘stairs license’ and can confidently climb several floors. Rambo has a lot of love to give, and would therefore thrive in a calm environment. While he’s very obedient and respectful, Rambo is still working on his skills of independence and improving his confidence when being left alone for longer periods of time. He would enjoy a home with a laid back type of life. Known to roach and chill out, Rambo would be an amazing addition for a laid back couple with some hours alone, retirees due to his gentle nature, or a work from home lifestyle, as long as he gets a couple of short toilet walks around the block. He is well versed in being an apartment hound, but of course he would love a backyard if you had one too! Rambo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Rambo is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Willow is a cute girl, who is social with greyhounds, small dogs and cats here at our Western Sydney adoption centre. She does well on walks, showing off her nice leash manners. She would do well with a confident/calm dog or cat friend. Willow could suit a house with a backyard or a unit/apartment as she is good at stairs and settles well on her own inside and outside Willow's friendly disposition makes her great for families looking to add a companion who’s both loving and easy going. She gets along wonderfully with animals and would thrive in a household where she can share her days with furry siblings. She’s ready to become a beloved member of your family, filling your home with warmth, joy, and countless tail wags. Enquire with the Western Sydney team to meet her.

NAME: Jackson
TEXT: Jackson is a sweet boy with a lot of love to give! He is polite with big and small dogs and would enjoy further socialisation and getting to know other dogs and people! He would enjoy a home with another canine companion and has shown to be polite with all sizes. We think Jackson would enjoy a quiet neighbourhood to enjoy the serenity, and older respectful children who can give him space when he needs some peace and quiet. Jackson is also suited to living in an apartment home. We know Jackson will make a wonderful pet! Jackson is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pocket
TEXT: Pocket is a bouncy, fun little thing! She would enjoy a yard to call her own and while not a necessity, she would enjoy living with another medium to large doggie friend. She is a wiggly, adorable, affectionate girl who is known for her love of toys and fun loving personality. We are still getting to know Pocket here at the Western Sydney adoption centre so check back soon for updates. Pocket is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Grace is a cute little girl who's spent time around kids 5-10 years old. Her playful spirit will surely keep the little ones entertained while you enjoy her affectionate and charismatic nature. She is a confident, vibrant girl who will enjoy an active lifestyle and a backyard to call her own. She is suitable to live with other medium-large hounds, too. We are still getting to know Grace at the adoption centre so stay tuned for updates. She is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dumpling
TEXT: This small and cute little dumpling is bursting with happiness and affection. She definitely has a playful side (check out the cute video!), she will delight you with her bouncy zoomies and goofy play! Dumpling loves her humans and would suit a home where someone is home more often than not. However she does also love the company of other medium-large sized dogs and would be more than happy to wait for full time workers to get home if she had another hound to hang out with. A home with older, respectful children would be fine by Dumpling provided they don't mind her bubbly energy. We’re hoping dumpling won’t be on the GAP menu long! Fill out an application online today to place your order!

NAME: Tara
TEXT: Meet Tara! This affectionate girl thrives on human companionship and is always eager to shower you with love and attention. She’s social with other medium/large sized dogs, so she’d fit in perfectly in a home with other canine companions - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Londonderry location. She also could do well as the only dog, as long as she’s getting all the affection she deserves. Given a little time to settle into her new home and as she adjusts to new surroundings, she’ll quickly show you just how loving and loyal she can be!

NAME: Kenneth
TEXT: Kenneth is a sweet gentle soul who is a darling on the lead and an overall laid back boy. Being middle aged, he's ready to take it easy and enjoy the retirement life. He's a friendly and affectionate boy who is suitable to live with respectful children and big or small doggies. Suitable for a backyard/townhouse, this laid back boy suits many home types! He has the sweetest little face with an adorable personality to match. Come meet Kenneth at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Bill
TEXT: Bill is a calm, gentle and affectionate boy. He loves to lean on his people for pats, making it hard to get a good photo! Bill would suit a relaxed and laid back home with or without children. A few hours alone will suit Bill well, and full time hours with a doggie companion, too! We think Bill will make an amazing addition to so many home types. He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Etna
TEXT: Etna is a sweet and affectionate 2-year-old greyhound with a loving nature and a confident personality. She adores playtime but is just as happy lounging around for a pat. Soft and small in size, Etna is perfect for someone looking for a low-maintenance but affectionate companion. She’s comfortable being left alone during the day, making her an excellent fit for full-time workers. Etna has been around children as young as 3 and is very gentle. If you’re after a friendly and loving greyhound who will brighten your home with her playful yet gentle nature Etna is the dog for you.

NAME: Mary (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Mary is a vibrant young girl who loves spending time around other dogs. She enjoys playtime with other breeds of dogs (a Staffy and Doberman are her favourites!) and is showing to be suitable to live with cats pending proper introductions. This bubbly little lady has been raised in a domestic environment, making her transition into being a pet an easier one for both dog and family. She has been around kids 7 and up and would easily suit a home with respectful children. She is still young-spirited, so a backyard, mental enrichment and daily walks will see Mary thrive in her forever home as she grows up along side you. Mary is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Shadow
TEXT: Lurking in the shadows is this beautiful boy! Shadow is learning 'pet prep' in his current home, which includes spending time indoors, spending time with children, and small dogs! Having been around kids 10 years old and over, as well as 3 small dogs - Jack Russel, Pomeranian and Dachshund, he has perfected the art of the top 2 greyhound past times - playing and sleeping together. Shadow would be a wonderful addition to a family with dogs, children, and a townhouse/backyard for Shadow to enjoy spending time in. Shadow would enjoy being a member of the family and being included on walks, adventures, and cuddling watching TV at night. Shadow is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Naomi
TEXT: Naomi is a sweet & shy girl. She is suitable to live with other dogs including small dogs! Although initially shy, she is a brave girl who warms up well with consistent, gentle handling. Naomi would enjoy a quiet home with a grassy courtyard/backyard. She likes to keep to herself but travels well and is working on her confidence every day. If you're looking for a sweet and gentle hound who you can watch thrive with your nurturing personality, consider adopting Naomi. Naomi is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Spider
TEXT: Spider is a charming and gentle boy. He is playful and engaging as well as a big softie who loves affection. He would be great for full time workers since he chills out comfortably on his own.

NAME: Mattie
TEXT: Maddie is a confident, social and playful hound. She is a funny and quirky girl who has been in the home, gone on trips to bunnings, hung around the kids at footy training and can be left in a yard on her own. She is great in the car.

NAME: Huckleberry
TEXT: This is Huckleberry 🐾 A sweet, playful boy ready to bring lots of fun and love into his new home! Huckleberry is super friendly, affectionate and loves to play. With the help of his favourite treats, Huckleberry picks up on training very quickly, showing he's not just a pretty face! If you’re home more often or have another medium to large dog, Huckleberry could fit right in! Whether you’re looking for a walking buddy or a happy face to greet you at the door, Huckleberry is your guy. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Rich
TEXT: *Rich is in a foster care unit apartment & is available to adopt - reach out to the team for more info!* A handsome boy who’s ready to cash in on his forever home! He may be a little shy at first, but once he gets to know you, he’s sweet, affectionate, and a total cuddle bug. He’s a low-key kinda guy who would thrive in a calm, quieter environment but may be able to share his new home with children or another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet. So, if you’re looking for a sweet soul with a lot of love to give, don’t miss out on meeting this handsome boy down at Western Sydney 🐾

NAME: Dianne
TEXT: Diane is a sweet girl, she can take some time to warm up but is doing better every day! She loves her treats and can be won over easily with a pocket full of treats. She enjoys spending time with other greyhounds and would suit a forever home with another M-L canine companion. Her best suited home would be one in a quieter area, away from the hustle and bustle. She would enjoy a backyard or townhouse to lay in the sunshine. She can go up and down the stairs at the GAP centre and doesn't mind being left alone for a few hours, too. She is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Maddie
TEXT: Meet Maddie – a sweet, gentle girl with a heart full of kindness. Affectionate and calm, she’s a natural with young children and loves being part of a family. Maddie grew up alongside a cattle dog and has been around goats, so she’s comfortable with other animals and familiar with farm life. With her loving nature and easygoing spirit, Maddie is the perfect companion 🐾💛.

NAME: Chief
TEXT: Meet Chief – a handsome, easy-going boy with a heart of gold. This laid-back fella is happy entertaining himself or just chillin' solo 😎. Patient and gentle, Chief is great with small children and gets along well with other animals. He grew up around a cattle dog and has been exposed to goats, so farm life is nothing new to him. Whether he's playing or relaxing in the sun, Chief brings a calm, loyal energy to any home 🐾.

NAME: Scout
TEXT: Scout is a playful and goofy greyhound who brings a sense of fun and adventure wherever he goes. His fun-loving nature, combined with his sweet personality, makes him an ideal companion for any family. Scout's zest for life ensures that there's never a dull moment when he's around. Scout's playful demeanor means he gets along well with people and other pets. His adventurous spirit makes him a great match for families who enjoy outdoor activities and playtime. Scout would thrive in a home that can match his playful spirit and provide plenty of opportunities for fun and adventure. A family that loves to play and explore will find a perfect companion in Scout. At the same time, his sweet nature means he also enjoys quiet moments of affection and relaxation.

NAME: Lyla
TEXT: Lyla is a delightful girl with a fun personality that is perfectly balanced by her sweet and gentle nature. Her vibrant ways and affectionate demeanor make her a favorite among everyone she meets. Lyla's charm and warmth are sure to bring joy to any household. Lyla's friendly and gentle nature means she gets along well with people and other dogs. She makes her a wonderful companion for families or individuals looking for an active yet loving friend. Lyla would thrive in a home where she can share her love and affection. A family that enjoys playtime and outdoor activities would be perfect for her. At the same time, she appreciates quiet moments of affection and will happily snuggle up for some downtime.

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Pepper has a kind and gentle nature that instantly wins over everyone she meets. She’s easygoing, affectionate, and loves being part of the action, whether it’s with her human family or her fellow dog friends. Pepper’s playful yet calm demeanor makes her a joy to be around, and she’s ready to share her love with the lucky family who takes her home!

NAME: Dennis
TEXT: Dennis is a quiet, sweet, and gentle boy who is looking for a loving home that understands his shy nature. He thrives in a calm and stable environment where he can feel safe and secure. With a little patience and a lot of love, Dennis will blossom into a confident and happy companion. Dennis is great with other dogs, both big and small, making him a wonderful addition to a household with existing pets. His gentle demeanor ensures he gets along well with everyone he meets. Dennis would do best in a home that can provide him with plenty of love and encouragement. A calm setting will help him feel at ease and allow his true personality to shine.

NAME: Alvie
TEXT: Alvie is a delightful greyhound with a perfect blend of confidence and sweetness. He’s brimming with personality and absolutely adores affection, making him a wonderful companion for anyone looking for a loyal and loving friend to do life with. Alvies love for affection suggests that he's not just a pet, but a true companion who thrives on human interaction. Whether it's snuggling on the couch, going for walks, or simply being by your side, Alvie's presence is sure to bring warmth and joy to any household. His personality shines through in everything he does, making him a delightful and loyal friend who is always ready to share his love

NAME: Ally
TEXT: Ally never raced, but she’s won many hearts with her chilled-out demeanor and sweet disposition. Her relaxed attitude makes her a joy to be around, and her gentle spirit means she’s happy to go with the flow. Whether she’s lounging in the sun, playing ball or burrowing in her bed. Ally is currently in a foster home with a toddler who she adores and is very gentle with, she loves kids. She is also with a medium size dog and a sausage dog, needless to say Ally is an all-round easy-going girl!

NAME: Deanie
TEXT: Deanie is the cutest of puppies, a girl who will melt your heart with her puppy eyes and goofy ways. She just loves the kids 7 and 11 years old, loves to go on walks and is good on the lead. She's still a puppy and is learning not to jump up. She's friendly towards the household cat and, after being a bit excited at first, follows the Maltese around. Deanie is the sweetest puppy who just loves to play, meet new people , snuggle up to you and go for walks. Best suited to an experienced dog/greyhound owner to continue her education, and guidance to become the beautiful, loveable companion she is destined to be.

NAME: Adelaide
TEXT: Adelaide is a pretty blue girl. She knows her name, comes when she is called and is a delight to be around. She has had great pet prep experience coming in and out of the home. She would suit most homes.

NAME: Flint
TEXT: **Flint is in a foster care home in a unit apartment - reach out to the team to find out more!** Flint is a polite gentleman when it comes to people & other dogs. He would suit a calm canine friend in his forever home. He’s all about manners and will leave you impressed with how well he interacts with both humans and other greyhounds. Flint is quick to learn and takes training in stride, making him a highly trainable and adaptable companion. He is currently in a foster care home where he is picking up all the pet skills to be the best pet he can be for when he finds his forever home. Flint is a polite young man who can't wait to meet you. He's available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cassie
TEXT: Cassie is a stunning white hound with a fawn patch or two, making her not only eye catching, but very unique! This 4 year old girl is confident and affectionate with new people and would be suitable around respectful children. She would suit a home with other medium to large dogs in the home, and a backyard to enjoy exploring and sniffing. Cassie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pete
TEXT: For Pete's sake, look at this handsome boy! Pete is a shy and reseved boy looking for a calm, low stimulus home to enjoy his retirement. Pete would do best without children and would love a backyard to retreat to when things get too busy for him. Pete is a delight around other greyhounds and gains confidence around them. A nurturing and relaxed owner would suit him the best. We think he would love to either live with another greyhound and/or continue socialisation around other dogs. Pete is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Matt
TEXT: Matt is a handsome, dark brindle boy with a striking coat. He has a confident and positive demeanour and has spent most of his days around other greyhounds, making him a lovely addition to a home with another hound. Described as calm, easy going and peaceful, this gorgeous boy has been doing well at the GAP centre with his training and due to his laid back nature we think a home with children would suit him well, too! Matt is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lloyd
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Lloyd! 💙 Lloyd may be a little shy when meeting new people, but with a supportive and understanding family, he quickly blossoms into a confident, happy, and loving boy. 🐶 Smart and full of potential, Lloyd is just waiting for the right people to help him shine. If you're looking for a sweet companion who’ll grow into your best buddy, Lloyd is ready to meet you! 💫

NAME: Pearl
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Pearl! 🌟 Pearl is a very sweet and easygoing lady with a heart full of love and a sharp mind to match. 🧠💕 She’s always eager to learn and picks up on things quickly, making her a joy to be around. She’s happy spending time on her own or with others, and she’s great with young children. Pearl’s also had some exposure to farm life—including goats! 🐐 If you're looking for a calm, clever companion, Pearl is ready to shine in her forever home! 🐶✨

NAME: Flick
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Flick! 🐶💛 Flick is a happy-go-lucky lady with a gentle soul and a love for life (and treats!). 🍖 She’s playful, sweet, and has a calm nature that makes her wonderful around small and young children. She’s spent time indoors and even had some exposure to farm life—including goats! 🐐 Whether she’s enjoying cuddle time or playtime, Flick’s joyful spirit shines through. Looking for a loving, easygoing companion? Flick might just be your perfect match! 💕

NAME: Flow
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Flow! 🌸 Flow is a very sweet girl with a heart full of potential. 💕 She's ready to learn, grow, and succeed with the help of a loving, supportive home. With a little training and plenty of encouragement, she’ll blossom into an amazing companion. She’d do best with older, understanding children and could be a great match for a calm, medium-large dog friend. If you're looking for a kind soul to grow with, Flow is ready to start her journey with you! 🐶💫

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jasper! 💙 Jasper is an affectionate, sweet, and kind-hearted boy who just wants to be loved. 🐶 He’s playful and gentle, with so much potential to shine in the right home. He’s still learning and will need a supportive family to continue his training and help build his confidence. Jasper would do best with older, understanding children and could get along well with a compatible medium-large dog. If you're ready to open your heart to a truly lovable companion, Jasper is waiting for you! 💕

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Reggie! 🐶 Reggie is an active, playful, and seriously handsome boy! 😍 He's full of energy and would love a yard where he can run, play, and burn off that puppy spirit. Still working on his manners, Reggie needs a patient, understanding family ready to guide him with love and consistency. He’d do best with older kids and could be a great match for a friendly medium-large dog buddy. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion to grow with, Reggie’s your guy! 💙

NAME: Emma
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Emma! 💖 Emma is a gentle soul with so much love to give. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and kindness, her sweet personality shines through. 💕 She’s looking for a calm, supportive family to help her grow in confidence with continued training and socialisation. Emma enjoys the company of well-mannered dogs (especially larger ones!) and would do best with older, understanding children. A secure yard to play and explore would be the cherry on top for this lovely girl. 🐶🌿

NAME: Jodie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jodie! 💕 Jodie is a sweet, goofy girl with a big heart and an even bigger personality! 💖 She’s bursting with playful energy and would love a yard where she can zoom around and enjoy all her favorite games. Jodie is still learning the ropes, so she’ll need a patient, loving home committed to helping her grow with consistent training and gentle guidance. 🐶 She’d thrive with older, understanding kids and could do well with a medium-large dog friend who matches her vibe. If you’re ready to laugh, play, and love a little extra every day—Jodie’s your girl! 💕

NAME: Benson
TEXT: Meet Benson – A Gentle Giant with a Heart Full of Love 💙🐾 Benson is a sweet, kind-hearted boy who’s still finding his way in the world. This gentle giant is looking for a calm, supportive home where he can grow in confidence, surrounded by patience, understanding, and lots of love. He’ll need ongoing training and encouragement, but with the right guidance, Benson will blossom into the most loyal companion. He’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are calm and respectful, and would do best with older, understanding children who can give him the space and gentleness he needs. If you have a little extra room in your home—and your heart—Benson might just be the perfect fit. 💛

NAME: Ducky
TEXT: Meet Ducky – A Sweet, Gentle Soul Ready for Her Cozy Forever Home 🐾💗 Ducky is a loving, affectionate older girl who’s all about the cuddles and calm vibes. She’s looking for a slower-paced home where she can enjoy the quiet life with people who appreciate the beauty of a relaxed routine. Ducky would love a family with older, understanding children, and she’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are respectful and calm like her. If you're after a sweet companion who just wants to be loved and lounge by your side, Ducky might be your perfect match 🐾💗

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Goofy – A Special Boy Looking for His Special Home 🐶💛 Goofy is a sweet male with a quirky charm and a heart ready to bond. He’s looking for a quiet, patient home where he can take things at his own pace. Goofy needs someone who understands that dogs like him need time, gentle guidance, and a whole lot of love to build trust. He’s still learning about the world, so training and socialization will be key to helping him grow into his best self. Goofy would do best as the only dog in the home, with older, understanding children who can respect his boundaries. With the right people, Goofy will shine – could that be you?

NAME: Sofia
TEXT: Meet Sofia – A Loving Blue Beauty Looking for Her Forever Home 💙🐾 Sofia is a beautiful blue female with a gentle soul and a heart full of potential. She's looking for a home that can offer her support, understanding, and time—someone patient and committed to helping her grow with continued training and care. Sofia has an old injury to her front leg, so she’ll need a family that understands her physical needs and can help her feel safe and comfortable. She thrives best as a single dog in the household and would be happiest with older, dog-savvy children who can respect her space and needs. If you’re ready to offer a calm, loving home where Sofia can continue her journey, she’s ready to meet you. 💙

NAME: Red
TEXT: Red is a beautiful blue female on the smaller side. She is playful and happy, she is also quick to settle and relax. She is familiar with the native birds that visit and gets along with everyone.

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal! The King of Cuddles and Playtime! 🐾 If you're looking for a loyal companion who’s both noble and a bit goofy, Royal is ready to bring you love, fun and lots of personality. This charming greyhound enjoys his toys and loves to play! Royal walks beautifully on lead and adores his daily walks. He's polite around smaller dogs but would prefer to share his kingdom with a medium or large canine companion. Ready to give Royal his happily ever after? Come and meet this beautiful boy at Western Sydney...he’s been waiting for his crowning moment! 👑

NAME: Zero
TEXT: Meet Zero! Don't let the name fool you, because this sweet greyhound has infinite love to give! This sweet and gentle girl is the full package. She's affectionate, easygoing, and happiest when she’s close to her humans. Zero enjoys being showered with pats and is always up for a relaxing car ride where she can watch the world go by. Zero is happy to live with medium to large dog companions and might even get along with a small dog, pending a meet and greet. She’s calm, loving, and has a beautiful nature that shines through in everything she does. If you’re looking for a loyal friend with a heart of gold and a tail that wags for days, Zero might just be your number one. Come meet her Western Sydney! 🐾

NAME: Lou (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Lou! A stunning young lady with a zest for life and a love for adventure! This energetic girl is always ready to go and would be the perfect match for an active home that enjoys long walks and fun outings. She’s a dream travel companion and hops into the car like a pro, always eager for her next big excursion. Lou currently lives with a male greyhound and gets along beautifully with him – she’s social and sweet with her own kind. Lou is best suited to a home in an area with few small dogs, as she has a strong interest in them and will need ongoing management in those situations. A secure home that understands her needs and is committed to helping her thrive will be the key to her success. With the right support and plenty of adventure time, Lou is sure to flourish and bring endless joy, energy, and elegance to her lucky new family. Lou is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Hank (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hank is in a foster care home, living within a retirement village with his foster carer. He enjoys laid back walks alongside his foster carer who uses a walker. He is wonderfully laid back and gentle. He is a dream to walk on the lead and would enjoy a similarly calm forever home. His foster carer has described him as 'beautiful', 'divine', and has noted that he is great with kids and other people he's met out on strolls around the complex. He's especially taken to the grandkids who are 12+ years old. He loves to play and collect items. He's so friendly and everyone loves him. The foster carer notes he doesn't need a lot of space (as they have a small villa yard), loves his walks, is great with the mobility walker, and is a lovely, friendly, playful and perfect first foster greyhound for their living situation. If you are retired, living a laid back life, use a walker, or just looking for a calm companion, do not hesitate to reach out to the adoption team to discuss adopting Hank. Hank is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Thor
TEXT: Thor – Mighty God of thunder and lightning and protector of mankind...this friendly boy from the moment he meets you, he’ll be buttering you up with his big puppy dog eyes asking for a treat. If you have an Avengers team of other hounds at home, we think that Thor wouldn’t mind some crime-fighting canine company, but he’s happy on his own as well for shorter stints of time alone to begin with. He would do best with a small grassed yard with opaque/colour bond fencing in a quiet neighbourhood as he can become overwhelmed with too much going on in the neighbourhood. His gentle and friendly nature would see him fit perfectly into a home with older kids or teens! If Thor (minus the hammer) sounds like the perfect fit for your Asgard, assemble your family, and together you can embark on a heroic journey to meet him at our Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Conrad
TEXT: Foster Update - he is a gentle, sweet, little old man who is a quiet observer...more foster update below: 🐾 Conrad is truly a sweet and gentle boy who is very affectionate 🐾 He doesn’t bark, whinge or whine 🐾 He comes when called & he loves being wherever you are 🐾 Suitable for full time hours, stays outdoors during that time 🐾 He comes across as an old man, quiet and observant 🐾 Conrad won't get up on couches 🐾 Sleeps outside at night quietly and doesn't mind the possums 🐾 He likes walks & is OK with sirens, busy roads 🐾 Happy walking past junior rugby & groups of children 🐾 Great on doggie dates with other greyhounds 🐾 Learning to enjoy road trips 🐾 Tolerant of wild life & birds in the yard 🐾 The birds can have pool parties in his water bowl and will share his kibble with magpies! 🐾 Spent time with 12-14 year old kids who are dog savvy (who he chose to spend 'quiet time' on the floor with!) 🐾 Grown so much in confidence & is ready for his forever home! Conrad is a quiet natured, reserved yet affectionate boy. He is polite meeting other big or small dogs when out and about but would suit a home willing to take things slow while he learns about the world around him. He could happily co exist with another doggie with a similar gentle temperament. Conrad is enjoying foster care and has become so confident in new environments but will still require a patient home. Conrad is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre to meet him & his amazing foster carers.

NAME: Fletch
TEXT: Fletch is a pleasant boy who has house experience. He has lived around various breeds of dog and is friendly and social. He comes when called, relaxes on his own and is great company.

NAME: Poh
TEXT: Poh is a sweet well balanced boy. He will engage in playing fetch, quick zoom in the yard followed by some serious lounging around. He is good with kids and all dogs. He lives in a semi rural area and is familiar with native wildlife coming round like roos, wombats and native birds.

NAME: Buster
TEXT: Buster is a beautiful social boy, he gets along with all dog breeds and sizes. He lives on the south coast and has been visited by various native animals. He is happy to play in the yard, relax on his own or go out for a small adventure to Bunnings or the beach.

NAME: Tracey
TEXT: Tracey is a loving girl with a heart of gold and a very special talent—leaning! If you're standing still, she'll gently lean in close, just to let you know she loves you. Affectionate and calm, Tracey is happiest when she’s near her people. She’s great with other dogs, big or small, and absolutely adores children. Tracey is the kind of dog who fits right in and makes everyone feel at ease. Let’s be honest—everyone knows a girl called Tracey… so maybe it’s time you had one of your own! 💕🐾

NAME: George
TEXT: George is a calm and loyal boy who just loves to be by your side. He’s the kind of dog who’ll follow you around the house, not because he needs anything—he just likes to know what’s going on! A bit of a sticky beak, George is always curious and quietly watching the world around him. He’s great with dogs of all shapes and sizes and absolutely adores children. With his gentle nature and friendly personality, George makes a perfect family companion or best buddy for someone who wants a loving shadow. If you're after a sweet, loyal boy who will stick close and make every day brighter, George is ready to join your pack! 🐾🧡

NAME: Felix
TEXT: Felix is a chilled-out charmer who’s just happy to be part of the fun. He’s quiet, calm, and has a super relaxed nature—nothing really bothers him! Whether it's hanging out with other dogs or being around kids, Felix fits right in. He’s friendly, gentle, and goes with the flow. This sweet boy doesn’t have a care in the world—he’s just looking for a comfy spot, some love, and maybe a snack or two. Felix is the kind of dog who brings a little bit of sunshine into every day without ever asking for much in return. If you’re after a gentle, low-fuss companion who gets along with everyone, Felix might just be your perfect match. 🐾💙

NAME: Tylah
TEXT: Tylah is a beautiful, gentle soul who’s mastered the art of relaxing. She’s a laid-back lady who loves her naps and cozy spots, but don’t let that fool you—she still has her zoomie moments! Short bursts of energy are her specialty, followed by lots of lounging and cuddles. She’s happiest when she’s with her people, always close by and ready to share her calm, loving presence. Loyal, sweet, and full of quiet charm, Tylah is the kind of companion who makes every day feel a little more peaceful. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who will love being by your side (especially on the couch), Tylah might just be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Chellie
TEXT: Chellie is a gentle girl who starts off quiet but slowly opens up to reveal her playful side. She enjoys her toys and settles in best with a calm, gradual introduction to her new home. With a slow and safe intro, she may get along well with smaller dogs and cats. A sweet soul with lots of love to give once she feels secure.

NAME: Cc
TEXT: CC is the sweetest little tri-pod you’ll ever meet! Loving, affectionate, and always ready for cuddles, she loves to lean in close and soak up the snuggles. Playful and full of heart, she enjoys her fun but can tire a bit easily. CC is great with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction — a truly special girl looking for a loving home.

NAME: Digger
TEXT: Digger is a curious, affectionate boy who loves to learn and be involved in whatever you're doing. He’s attentive, enjoys playing with his toys, and thrives on interaction. Digger would do best as the only dog in the home and would love having older children to play and bond with.

NAME: Brad
TEXT: Brad is a lively, energetic boy once he feels at home. He enjoys playtime, especially in a backyard where he can stretch his legs and have fun. Brad is good with smaller dogs and would do well in a home with older children. A sweet, active companion ready for his next adventure!

NAME: Rafiki
TEXT: Rafiki is a lively, energetic boy with an incredible love for toys! He’s a one-dog fetch machine—happily tossing his own toys just to chase them down again. Social, interactive, and full of fun, Rafiki brings playful energy and joy wherever he goes.

NAME: Dempsey
TEXT: Dempsey is a fun-loving, affectionate boy with a big personality and an even bigger love for his toys. He's interactive, silly, and always ready to make you laugh with his goofy antics. Dempsey does well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A joyful companion who’s all about play, cuddles, and good vibes!

NAME: Oreo
TEXT: Oreo is a sweet and goofy boy who’s full of love and personality. Curious and attentive, he’s always up for fun and loves to be part of the action. Affectionate by nature, Oreo leans in for snuggles and soaks up all the attention he can get. He’s great with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction — a total sweetheart with a big, silly heart.

NAME: Zazu
TEXT: Zazu is a gentle male who takes a little time to settle in, but once he's comfortable, his playful and funny personality shines through. He absolutely loves his toys and enjoys exploring his surroundings with curiosity. Zazu gets along well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A sweet soul with a goofy side, he’s sure to bring joy and laughter to a patient and loving home.

NAME: Holly
TEXT: Holly is a delightful bubbly little girl, loves pats, cuddles and playing with kids 5-19, small dogs and big dogs, from a mini groodle to a Rottweiler, running around with them and sleeping next to them. She loves walks and is easy on the lead, even on busy streets. Holly has been living inside and is nearly housetrained, also crate-trained to sleep at night. She loves all people, ignores the household cat, and would need to live in a busy home with at least another dog to keep her company . She is calm and affectionate as well as a playful social butterfly! *Holly needs to be able to be fed separately from other dogs as she doesn't like sharing her food. 🍖

NAME: Horsey
TEXT: Horsey is an incredible work of art. He is a sculpted magnificent looking retired athlete. He does enjoy a play and a run. He does wipe out pretty quick like most sprinters once he has moved and will relax nicely. He is a gentle boy who loves everyone, he is a social and confident boy.

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Daisy is a lovely hound, she is very social, confident and friendly. She is great around everybody and will make an excellent addition to your life. She is good on the lead and great company.

NAME: Garry
TEXT: Garry is a true companion and ready to become anyone’s best friend. Garry is 4 years of age and has grown up in a residential home whilst also living with other greyhounds. Garry enjoys his daily walk around town and makes friends with the neighbourhood children and dogs on his walk. With the correct introduction Garry could he suited to younger children and would be amazing in a townhouse or apartment with a walk everyday.

NAME: Universe
TEXT: Universe is a friendly and loyal girl who just loves being close to her people—she’ll happily stay by your side and lean in for cuddles. She’s easy-going, fun, and has a sweet nature that makes her a joy to have around. Universe has met small dogs and, with a proper introduction, she’s happy to make new furry friends. If you're looking for a loving companion who wants to be part of your world, Universe is ready to shine in her forever home!

NAME: Blue
TEXT: Blue is a friendly and loyal boy who loves meeting new people with lots of enthusiasm! He greets everyone with gusto and is always happy to make new human friends. When it comes to dogs, Blue prefers medium to large breed pals and needs a good introduction, as he can get quite excited at first. He’s not a fan of small dogs, so he’d do best in a home with larger dog friends. If you’re looking for a loyal, lively companion who loves people and is ready to be part of the fun, Blue could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Rockstar
TEXT: Rockstar is the coolest, most laid-back guy around! Just like his name, he’s a chilled-out rockstar who loves attention and enjoys hanging out with people—especially kids. He’s great with all dogs and loves to play, making him the perfect companion for a fun-loving household. Rockstar is as friendly as they come and always ready to be part of the action. If you’re looking for a relaxed, happy, and playful buddy who’s always ready for some fun, Rockstar is your guy!

NAME: Queeny
TEXT: Queeny is a happy, very lovable and friendly young girl who loves life! She would be a great addition for a young couple or family with older kids on her own or with another greyhound or medium to large dog. She just wants to be part of your life, be a sticky beak, play, and have fun! She can also settle down and have a rest when needed, inside or out in a large yard. She has been around a lot of people coming and going in an office environment, noises don't worry her. Queeny loves to wander around the yard and play, then sleep inside with other retired greys during the day or in her own indoor kennel. She is used to walking on lead, loves pats and is well-behaved when given love and attention. She would adore a new home to settle into with her own special people be your loyal companion. 🥰

NAME: Pretty
TEXT: Meet Pretty! 💖 Personality: Sweet, friendly, and happy! Pretty in name and nature!!!! Pretty is a gentle, sweet-natured girl who is friendly with everyone she meets—both people and dogs! She’s quick to settle and enjoys a relaxed, calm environment. Her lovely personality makes her the perfect companion for a variety of homes. If you’re looking for a happy and easy-going dog with a heart full of love, Pretty could be the one for you!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet Bruce! 🖤 Bruce is a sweet, laid-back boy with a charming personality. He gets along well with small dogs and is always happy to spend time with his human friends. Bruce does have pannus, a condition that affects his eyes. While it's not curable, it’s easily managed with treatment to keep him comfortable. If you’re looking for a friendly, easy-going companion with a big heart, Bruce is ready to bring his charm into your life!

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a strong, happy, and fun-loving boy who adores people and loves to play! He’s always up for some fun with his favorite toys—he absolutely loves them and could play all day. Sonny gets along great with medium to large breed dogs and would be happiest with a female dog friend. He’d also love to have a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. If you’re looking for an energetic and toy-obsessed companion with a heart full of love, Sonny might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Zadie
TEXT: Zadie is a sweet and laid-back girl who’s always ready to have fun! She loves to play and tries to make friends with the dogs she meets—she’s got a playful side that’s sure to bring some joy to your day. Zadie is also a big fan of pats and loves interacting with people. Her happy, friendly nature makes her the perfect companion for anyone looking for a fun and affectionate dog. Zadie has met small dogs and would be suited to go with a small dog friend who is easy going and playful. If you're looking for a playful, easy-going greyhound who loves people, Zadie is ready to meet you!

NAME: Jerry
TEXT: Jerry is a big-hearted boy with a lot of enthusiasm for life! He’s strong and full of energy, but also very lovable and always happy to say hello. He absolutely loves going for walks and is a big fan of sniffing everything along the way—every walk is an adventure for Jerry! He’s met small dogs a few times and has settled well, but he would need slow, careful introductions to help him feel comfortable. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate companion who’s always up for a walk and a cuddle, Jerry could be your perfect match!

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus is a beautiful, independent lady who is an absolute delight to have around. She’s perfectly happy relaxing on her own but still enjoys some attention and pats when you're nearby. She’s been socialised with small dogs and, while she’s not overly interested in them, she’s calm and well-behaved in their company. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance companion who enjoys both quiet time and a little love, Venus could be the one for you! She may be nearly 8 years old but she still has lots of love to share.

NAME: Jules
TEXT: Meet Jules! 🐾 Jules is a curious and affectionate young boy who loves going for walks—and he’s a dream on the lead, walking calmly with a nice loose leash. He’s always keen to check out the world around him and loves exploring new sights and smells. Jules is also a big fan of ear rubs and kisses—he’s a real sweetheart at heart! He can get a bit excited around small dogs, so he'd do best with medium to large breed dog friends who match his playful energy. If you’re after a gentle, curious companion with a lot of love to give, Jules might just be the perfect fit!

NAME: Matty
TEXT: Matty is a relaxed and happy boy who loves nothing more than a pat and a tasty treat! He’s very friendly and has been socialised with small dogs, making him a lovely companion for a variety of homes. With his calm nature and sweet personality, Matty is the kind of dog who just wants to hang out, enjoy your company, and maybe sneak an extra snack or two! If you’re looking for an easy-going buddy with a big heart, Matty’s your guy.

NAME: Cia
TEXT: Meet Cia! 💙 Cia may be nearly 8, but she’s young at heart and full of love! She’s a happy, friendly girl who enjoys the simple things in life—like a short walk, a comfy bed, and a ride in the car (one of her favourite things!). Cia is social with other dogs and gets along best with large breeds or calm small dogs. She’s easy-going and loves being part of the action, but also knows how to relax and take it easy. Cia thinks an apartment would be fine as long as she does not have to walk up and down stairs. If you’re after a sweet and gentle companion who still has a spring in her step, Cia could be the perfect match!

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: Meet Lenny! 🐶 Lenny is a fun-loving, easy-going boy who’s full of charm! He absolutely loves spending time with kids, making him a great family companion. One of his favourite things in the world is water—Lenny is a big fan of swimming! But don’t worry, he’s also got a lazy side and is always up for a nap or a cuddle on the couch. Lenny is very social and gets along well with all friendly dogs. He’s always happy to say hello and make new friends. If you're looking for a gentle, playful, and affectionate dog who loves both splashing and snoozing—Lenny is your guy!

NAME: Jethro
TEXT: Meet Jethro 🐾 Jethro is a quiet, easy-going boy who just needs a little time to show his sweet side. At first, he might come across as a bit of a sad sack—but don’t let that fool you! He’s loving, gentle, and really enjoys a good pat and some one-on-one time. While Jethro is usually calm, he can get a bit excited when meeting small dogs for the first time. The good news is he does settle down once he’s had a moment. If you’re after a laid-back companion with a soft heart and soulful eyes, Jethro could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a handsome, happy, and playful boy who’s full of personality! He loves life and enjoys being around people and other dogs—especially other greyhounds. Bob is strong and can get a little overexcited around small dogs, so he’d do best in a home without them. He would love to live with a medium to large female dog, or he’d be just as happy as the only dog in the home. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a big heart and a beautiful brindle coat, Bob could be your perfect match!

NAME: Be
TEXT: Be is a sweet and friendly boy who loves going for walks and spending time with his people. At just 2 years old, he’s still full of playful energy and curiosity about the world! He’s been introduced to small dogs, but can be a bit too bouncy for them—so he’d do best with a medium to large dog buddy who can match his playful style. Be would really love a home with a secure yard where he can stretch out, relax, and enjoy the sunshine between walks. He’s ready to bring lots of love, tail wags, and fun to his forever home!

NAME: Strawberry
TEXT: Meet Strawberry, a quiet and calm greyhound with a wonderfully laid-back and easy-going nature. She’s patient and gentle, making her a dream companion for a peaceful home. Best suited as a single dog household, Strawberry is cat workable and has experience living indoors, so she’s already familiar with home life. A sweet soul looking for a calm place to call her own.

NAME: Albert
TEXT: Albert is a calm and gentle 10-year-old greyhound with a heart of gold currently enjoying time in a foster care home. Albert’s pace is relaxed, preferring to spend his days lounging in the sun or curled up on a soft bed, soaking in the peace and comfort of his home. He loves his quiet moments, whether it’s a lazy afternoon nap or a leisurely walk around the neighbourhood. His laid-back nature makes him the perfect companion for those who enjoy slow, serene walks and cozy time at home. Albert has shown us that given time to settle in he may be good for full-time workers and be able to settle at home or with a similar sized doggy friend! Despite his age, Albert has a youthful spark. He’s always up for a bit of playtime, but at his own relaxed pace. His gentle demeanour makes him easy-going and adaptable, and he thrives in calm environments. Whether he’s by your side, enjoying a peaceful moment together, or watching the world go by from his favourite sunny spot, Albert is the kind of dog who will make you feel loved and appreciated every day. Albert may be in his golden years, but his gentle nature and serene presence make him an ideal companion for anyone looking for a loyal, loving friend. Come and meet him at our Londonderry Adoption Centre.

NAME: Wolfie
TEXT: Wolfie is the sweetest older gentleman you will ever meet! At 8 years old, he still has plenty of life and love to give. With his soft demeanor and loving nature, Wolfie is the perfect companion for anyone seeking a loyal and affectionate friend. He has a calm and soothing presence, making him an ideal pet for a any household. His loving and affectionate nature means he enjoys cuddles and spending quality time with his human family. Wolfie is a delight to be around, always ready to offer a comforting nuzzle. He has been living with a Cavoodle and is good with other dogs both big and small.

NAME: Brooke
TEXT: Introducing Brooke! A gentle soul with a heart full of affection and the sweetest nature you could hope for. Quiet and loving, she adores human connection, happily leaning in for cuddles and trotting over when called. Brooke is the kind of companion who will quietly fill your days with warmth, love, and loyalty. She’s shown calm, considered interactions with small dogs and responded well to gentle guidance, though she may need a bit of support as she gains confidence in new situations. With her gentle personality, Brooke could thrive in an apartment setting, especially with a patient and understanding family who can give her the time and support she needs to settle in. With love and kindness, Brooke is ready to blossom into the perfect best friend. Brooke is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Rowdy
TEXT: Meet Rowdy! The handsome social butterfly with a heart full of love and a nose for treats! This confident and friendly guy absolutely adores people and will charm his way into your heart (and maybe your snack stash) in no time. Rowdy is super trainable and eager to learn, especially if food or toys are involved – a home that is interested in furthering his training and development is ideal Rowdy is still learning the ropes when it comes to other animals, so he’s best suited as a solo dog or with another greyhound friend who can help him find his groove. He’d thrive in a home with a yard to explore and a family who can support him through his transition to pet life. With a little guidance and a lot of love, Rowdy will be the ultimate loyal companion – cheeky, charming, and full of fun. Rowdy is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Ham
TEXT: Meet Ham, a very sweet and gentle big boy with a heart full of love! He thrives on company, making him perfect for a home with part-time workers or someone who’s around often. Ham is great with younger children, small dogs, and cats, and his playful, interactive nature ensures there’s never a dull moment. With his sweet temperament, he’ll quickly become the most loyal companion!

NAME: Bane
TEXT: Meet Bane, a happy and sweet female greyhound with a playful side and a little bit of cheekiness! She’s curious and patient, always ready to explore her surroundings. Bane is great with smaller dogs and cats, making her a wonderful addition to a multi-pet household. Her gentle nature and playful energy will surely brighten up your day!

NAME: Chloe
TEXT: Meet Chloe, a sweet and affectionate female greyhound with a fun-loving spirit! She’s playful and loves a good game of fetch, always ready for some action. Confident and social, Chloe is great with smaller dogs, cats, and young children, making her the perfect family companion. Her sweet nature and playful energy will bring joy to any home!

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet this laid-back, placid boy—our sweet male Blaze! He's the definition of a "dopey" cuddle bug who loves nothing more than a good snuggle. As a single dog household pup, he's very content with his quiet life in the backyard, and he's happy to share his space with older children who understand his calm nature. Experienced owners will appreciate his lazy demeanor and gentle temperament. He’s all about relaxing and enjoying the simple things in life!

NAME: Dusty
TEXT: Dusty is a fun and playful greyhound with a heart full of love, a social butterfly who would love to be your next companion. He has a cheeky personality that makes everyone smile. His playful antics and affectionate nature make him a joy to be around. Dusty enjoys his daily walks and will be sure to curl up next to you for some quality cuddle time when the walk is done. Dusty is curious and loves to explore new places. Whether it’s a walk in the park or a hike in nature, he’s always up for an adventure. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and goofy companion, Dusty is the perfect greyhound for you! 🐾

NAME: Elsie
TEXT: Elsie is a calm, quiet, and easy-going lady who loves to take life at her own relaxed pace. At 4 years and 10 months old, she’s friendly and affectionate, always ready for a cuddle or a little bit of attention. She gets along great with all dogs, making her a wonderful companion for any doggy household. 🐶 Plus, Elsie could also be the perfect fit for a home with a laid-back cat, as she’s gentle and cruisy around other animals. 🐱 If you’re looking for a sweet, friendly, and calm companion who will happily relax by your side or enjoy peaceful walks, Elsie is the one for you! 💖

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for an adventure! He’s 4 1/2 years old and loves going for walks around the neighborhood, especially in suburban areas where there’s lots to sniff and explore. 🌳 This guy is also a big fan of the beach, with a special love for small shell pools—he’s happiest splashing around and enjoying the water! 🌊 Jack is great with other dogs and always ready to make new friends. His sweet, friendly nature makes him a joy to be around. Whether he’s on a walk or just chilling, Jack is sure to bring a smile to anyone he meets! 😊 If you’re looking for a fun, friendly companion who loves the outdoors, Jack is the perfect buddy for you! 🐕💖

NAME: Santa
TEXT: Santa Clause is coming to your lounge! Santa is a handsome 4 year old boy who is looking to be your perfect companion. Santa takes a little bit to warm up to new people but when he is comfortable he's the perfect mix of cuddly and playful. During the day Santa is perfect for fulltime workers as he spends his day sleeping and playing in the backyard. By night time You'll find Santa dreaming whilst curled up on the lounge or your bed with family or your other large fluffy companion.

NAME: Plucky
TEXT: Plucky is a friendly and independent greyhound with a charming personality! She loves spending time in her kennel and lounging on her bed, making her a cozy and content companion. With her plucky attitude, she’s full of confidence and doesn't mind doing her own thing. While she enjoys being around people, she also appreciates her personal space. If you're looking for a laid-back but lovable dog with a bit of spunk, Plucky is the perfect match!

NAME: Flossie
TEXT: Flossie is a lovely fawn greyhound with a playful and friendly personality! She gets along great with all dogs and loves spending time with children. Her favorite thing in the world? Water! Flossie loves to splash around and have fun in the water. She's a sweet and affectionate girl who will bring a lot of joy to any family or home. Playful, kind, and always up for an adventure, Flossie is the perfect companion!

NAME: Ferret
TEXT: Meet Ferret, a friendly and playful greyhound with a heart of gold! She's great with all other dogs and absolutely loves children, making her the perfect family companion. Ferret got her unique name because, as a pup, she would "ferret" her way to steal food from her mum—an adorable trait that stuck! She's gentle, affectionate, and always ready for a fun time. Whether it's running around or cuddling up, Ferret is sure to bring joy to any home!

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Looking for a spicy, high-energy pup to add some heat to your life? With her bold confidence and zest for adventure, Pepper will keep you on your toes and bring endless fun to your days. Whether it’s a brisk walk in the park, a game of fetch, or a playful romp with her doggy friends, Pepper’s always up for action and excitement. Her enthusiasm is contagious, and there’s never a dull moment with this fiery girl around! Pepper is confident, sociable, and loves to have a good time, especially with medium to large dogs who can match her energy. If you're looking for a fun-loving, playful companion to join in your outdoor adventures and keep the excitement rolling, Pepper’s the one for you! She’s the perfect addition to an active home where she can burn off some of that spicy energy and steal your heart with her fiery personality. Ready for a hot new addition to your family? Pepper can’t wait to meet you at the Western Sydney Facility!

NAME: Pirate
TEXT: Pirate is a lovely girl who gets her name since she has a patch over one of her eyes. She is social and confident, she is also very relaxed and calm. She would suit a life where she could live anywhere as long as she gets out for a walk daily to stay social.

NAME: Sweetie
TEXT: Sweetie is social and content, she has been walked by kids as part of her routine her whole life, she has seen a variety of animals and would suit a quiet life.

NAME: Simon
TEXT: Simon is a charming hound, he does like to stretch his legs with a morning zoomie and fetching toys. He burns himself almost straight away and enjoys being a lazy hound. He is a good mix of being an active hound that likes to relax also.

NAME: Dusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Howdy, partner! Name’s Dusty, and I’m a handsome greyhound lookin’ to saddle up and make some memories with ya! 🤠 I’m a social cowboy, friendly with folks and always up for a good ol’ chinwag. I get along great with medium and large dogs, and with a bit of further training and a meet-and-greet, I could be rustlin' up some friendships with smaller breeds too! 🐾 Now, I’m not one to turn down a good meal — I’m mighty food motivated! If you’ve got some tasty treats or a fun toy in your pocket, I’ll be the best partner-in-crime you could ask for! 🍖🎾 I’m also used to my crate, so I know when it’s time to rest in my own little space, but I’ll be rarin' to go when you’re ready for some fun! If you’re lookin' for a loyal, friendly companion with a heart as big as the Wild West, I’d be thrilled to join your posse. Let’s make this ride a whole lot more fun, partner! 🤠🌵

NAME: Maximo
TEXT: Maximo is a sporty and fun-loving greyhound with a passion for water and a heart full of love. Whether he’s splashing around in the pool or running around with his greyhound buddies, he’s always up for an active, fun time. Maximo is also fantastic with kids, having spent time with young ones and showing nothing but patience and gentleness. His easy-going nature and friendly demeanor make him a perfect fit for a family looking for a loving, playful companion. Maximo is also open to living with other dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and has the potential to coexist with small dogs and cats with the right training and introductions, and pending a meet and greet. His calm and cooperative attitude will make him a great addition to your home. If you’re looking for a sporty, fun, and affectionate dog who’s ready to join your team, Maximo could be the perfect match! Come meet him and see why he’s ready to take your home to the next level!

NAME: Riot
TEXT: Meet Riot, the epitome of easygoing! With a name that speaks to his spirit, Riot is ready to fill your days with joy and companionship. His gentle nature and playful antics make him an ideal addition to any home looking for a devoted friend. Riot has an amazing disposition that makes him friendly to people and pets alike. Through managed introductions, Riot has also shown to positively interact with cats! He'll fit into almost any living situation that keeps him active and allows him time for fun and an outdoor activities. He has been around kids 10+ and has proved to be a lovely, affectionate boy around all he meets. Riot is available at Western Sydney's adoption centre.

NAME: Ruby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Ruby, I'm pretty and petite like my gemstone name. I have a placid & quiet nature. I’m a sweet middle aged hound looking for a family who will love me forever. I would enjoy a backyard or townhouse to enjoy indoor outdoor living. I am a perfect addition if you're looking for a loving companion. I would like a home with calm kids and calm dogs so I can enjoy the quiet life with you. Like all greyhounds, I do have a little burst of energy and will zoom around and play with my toys, but don’t worry as soon as I’m finished you will find me in bed or laying in the sun. If you think this I could be suited to your home then apply to meet me today at our Londonderry site.

NAME: Noah
TEXT: Meet Noah – A Shy and Sweet Greyhound! Noah is a quiet and gentle male greyhound who may take a little time to warm up, but once he feels comfortable, he’s a loyal and loving companion. He’s a bit shy at first, so patience is key when getting to know him. Noah is great with small dogs and enjoys their company. His calm nature makes him a perfect fit for a peaceful home where he can feel safe and secure. If you’re looking for a quiet, sweet dog who will take time to build trust, Noah might just be the perfect companion for you!

NAME: Taylor
TEXT: Meet Taylor (aka Book Book) – A Sweet and Shy Greyhound! Taylor, also known as Book Book, is a lovely female greyhound with a gentle, shy personality. She might take a little time to warm up, but once she feels comfortable, she’s a sweet and loving companion. Taylor is great with small dogs, and her calm and quiet nature makes her a wonderful addition to any home. She’s also very clean, always keeping her space tidy and neat. If you’re looking for a sweet, quiet, and clean companion who will slowly but surely open up to you, Taylor is the perfect fit!

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Chandler is a beautiful fawn greyhound with a confident and friendly personality. She’s easygoing and loves making new friends, especially small dogs, with whom she’s always gentle and kind. Not only is she great with other pups, but Chandler is also a pro at stairs, making her a perfect fit for any home, no matter the layout. Her sweet, calm nature will bring joy to your family, and she’s always ready for a little playtime or snuggle session. If you are a fan of FRIENDS you will understand why they have named a gorgeous girl Chandler!!!!! If you're looking for a loving, confident dog to join your family, Chandler is the one!

NAME: Sam (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Looking for a fun-loving, people-obsessed companion? Sam the greyhound is your guy! 🐾 With his playful personality and endless enthusiasm, he’s ready to steal your heart and bring joy to every adventure. Sam is a total people pleaser, always eager for his human's attention and affection. He’s incredibly social and loves to be around his people, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a friendly, outgoing dog. Sam is also pro when it comes to car rides—he loves hopping in for a fun adventure and travels like a champ. Whether it’s exploring new environments or playing with his favorite toys, Sam is always up for the next exciting thing! He’s also a big fan of walks, where his playful, excitable personality shines. Sam is suitbale for living with other dogs around his size and would also be happy to share his home with older kids. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and energetic pup to share your life with, Sam is your guy! 🐕💙 Contact the Western Sydney team to meet Sam today!

NAME: Jane
TEXT: Jayne is a very smoochy and cuddly dog with a kind, sweet-natured personality. She’s highly affectionate and loves socializing with people. Confident and loving, she’d thrive in a home where she can receive plenty of attention. With the correct introduction, she might be okay with smaller dogs and cats, making her a great companion for a variety of households.

NAME: Collie

TEXT: Banj is a sweet, older female greyhound, ready to enjoy a relaxing retirement. She’s calm, easy-going, and laid-back, thriving in a peaceful home. NAME: Snoz
TEXT: Snoz is a male greyhound with a calm and quiet demeanor. He’s patient, easy-going, and always happy, enjoying a laid-back lifestyle. With his gentle nature, he’s the perfect companion for anyone seeking a relaxed and peaceful pet.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Bella, a sweet, kind, and patient female greyhound who remains calm in new environments. She’s excited to play and learn, always eager for new experiences. Bella is affectionate and loves to spend time with her humans, and she gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs. She’s ready to bring her gentle spirit and enthusiasm for life to a loving home!

NAME: Nova
TEXT: Meet Nova, a beautiful and sweet female greyhound who will melt your heart once she settles into her new home. She’s affectionate and loves cuddles, and she has a playful side when it comes to toys! Nova is patient and eager to learn, making her a wonderful companion for a family who can help her continue to grow. She’s ready to share her love and brighten your life!

NAME: Flyer
TEXT: Meet Flyer, a goofy, playful, and affectionate male greyhound who loves nothing more than a good cuddle!
