He’s been around smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks, and sheep, so he’s well-mannered around other animals. Flyer’s ready to fill your home with love and fun!

NAME: Blue
TEXT: Meet Blue, a fun-loving, high-energy male greyhound with a great spirit! He’s playful and full of personality, always ready for a game of fetch or a run around the yard. Blue would thrive in a home with a yard to stretch his legs and children to play with. He’s been around smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks, and even sheep, so he’s adaptable and gets along with a variety of animals. Blue is ready to bring his boundless energy and joy to a loving home!

NAME: Bec
TEXT: Meet Bec, a playful and affectionate female greyhound who absolutely loves toys! She enjoys collecting and playing with them, and there's nothing better than a cuddle and some quality time with her humans. Bec thrives in a home with an experienced owner who can provide her with the care and attention she needs, including a backyard to run and explore. She’s grown up around children, but older kids are best for her. She’s ready to bring love and joy into a forever home!

NAME: Zac
TEXT: Meet this gentle and shy male greyhound, looking for a loving, supportive family to help him continue to grow and thrive. With a quiet nature, he enjoys the simple pleasures of life, like collecting little toys, and he responds beautifully to a gentle touch. Having grown up around small children, he’s well-suited for a family environment. An experienced dog owner would be ideal, as he’s looking for someone who can provide the patience and care he needs to flourish.

NAME: Tony
TEXT: Tony is a barrel full of laughs, love & fun! This big goof ball loves to run, play & chase. He is an active boy with a spirit to match! He would love to find a home with older active children he can run around with in the backyard. Potentially another grey or large breed of dog to play with as well. He is a confident boy who doesn't shy away from much. Tony is ready to find his perfect family! Reach out to meet him today!

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Beautiful Lucy is lady who needs to find a supportive, patient & kind family. Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's, even your feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Sweet Missy is a darling girl looking for her perfect family. Missy is looking for love & support from her new family in order for her shine and grow into the best version of herself. A quiet & patient home would be best. With growth, she will shine in personality & playfulness. Missy responds well to young children. She has spent time living indoors with a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction, Missy might become best friends with your small pups or feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet her :)

NAME: Wichita
TEXT: Wichita is gorgeous, sweet girl, pretty chill but does get excited when running around with her other greymates! She absolutely loves water, a clam shell pool, which would keep her occupied as well as toys and is much quiter with the company of an older small dog as a companion but would also be happy as an only dog. She has such a loving nature, loves attention and pats, is well handled and good on lead. Better with older children, hasn't been around little ones. Wichi would make a lovely companion and walking buddy for couples, families with older kids and retirees, also happy to keep herself occupied for workers.

NAME: Jumbo
TEXT: Jumbo may have a giant name, but he's all lean speed and excitement! This sleek black greyhound is full of energy and enthusiasm, always ready to take on new adventures. He can be a little nervous at first, but it doesn’t take long for him to warm up and show his affectionate side. Once comfortable, he enjoys exploring his surroundings with a good sniff and settles in beautifully, just pure relaxation. With his lively spirit and charming nature, Jumbo is sure to make a big impression wherever he goes!

NAME: Betty
TEXT: Betty may be small in size, but she has a big heart! This lovely black greyhound is clean, quiet, and well-mannered, making her a wonderful companion. She gets along great with Boxers and other larger dogs, enjoying their company and playful energy. She’s good with kids and would be best suited to a home with children over five, as she can get a little excited at times. While she’s naturally quiet, once she comes out of her shell and feels comfortable, she shows her incredibly sweet and affectionate side. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving, and easy-going greyhound, Betty is ready to steal your heart!

NAME: Roxy
TEXT: Roxy is the definition of cool, calm, and collected. She loves her people and can't wait to spend her days surrounded by her family. She’s a dream to walk on the lead, making her a pleasure to take out and about. Roxy is fantastic mingling and walking with small dogs and other greyhounds but we think she would prefer to be the only dog in your home so she can get all the attention she deserves. If you’re looking for a relaxed, friendly companion who’s happy to go with the flow, Roxy is the perfect match!

NAME: Jumbo
TEXT: Jumbo has a fantastic energy! This big goof ball loves to run, play & explore! He would love to find a family with older children who can keep up :) Running around & playing in the backyard with his new best friends would suit him to a Tee! Jumbo has grown up around smaller breeds of dogs and he has had exposure to sheep, chicken & ducks. If you would like to meet Jumbo, please reach out :)

NAME: Alf
TEXT: Alf is as handsome and adorable as they come, he is super cute, placid, gentle, charming and engaging with people. Alf is a calm and gentle boy with little bursts of energy. He has shown potential to settle in crate but not a requirement. Alf is available from our Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: Clancy
TEXT: Clancy is a very sweet and lovely 3 1/2-year-old female greyhound. She’s polite with other dogs abut would be happy to have her home to herself. Clancy enjoys spending her time inside, relaxing on her mat, and soaking up all the love she can get. Why You'll Love Clancy: Sweet & Affectionate: Clancy is gentle, loving, and always ready for a cuddle. Polite with Other Dogs: She’s well-mannered and respectful around other dogs. Loves Indoor Relaxation: Clancy enjoys her cozy spot on the mat, making her a calm and easygoing companion. If you’re looking for a kind and calm greyhound to share your home, Clancy would be a perfect fit! 💕

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus may be 9 years old, but don’t let her age fool you – she certainly doesn’t act like it! This sweet, friendly girl is full of energy and loves being around people. She has the heart of a young pup and enjoys every moment spent with her humans. Venus is the perfect mix of a calm, affectionate companion and a fun-loving friend. Why You'll Love Venus: Friendly & People-Loving: Venus absolutely adores people and will be your best friend in no time. Young At Heart: Despite being 9 years old, Venus has the playful energy and spirit of a much younger dog! Calm & Affectionate: She loves cuddles and enjoys relaxing with you, but also has plenty of energy for playtime. If you’re looking for a loving, friendly greyhound who doesn’t act her age, Venus is the one for you! 💕

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Jett is a fun-loving and friendly female greyhound with a playful spirit and an easy-going personality. Born on April 3, 2022, she’s still young and full of energy but knows how to relax and enjoy quiet moments too. Jett’s happy, affectionate nature makes her a great companion for active families or anyone who enjoys a friendly, outgoing dog. Why You'll Love Jett: Playful & Friendly: Jett loves to have fun and is always ready to make new friends, whether it’s with humans or other dogs. Easy-Going: While playful, Jett is also calm and relaxed when it's time to chill. Young & Energetic: At just 2 years old, Jett has plenty of energy to enjoy walks, playtime, and adventures. If you’re looking for a sweet, friendly greyhound with a playful personality, Jett might be your perfect match! 💕

NAME: Red

NAME: Dutch
TEXT: Dutch is a sweet sensitive hound, he may be a bit shy and quirky at first but he does warm up and is very gentle and affectionate. He is a handsome boy who is calm and laid back. Relaxes well on his own.

NAME: Willow
TEXT: I'm attending the ACT Adoption Day on March 22nd! - Greyhound Adoption Event Canberra This is Willow! A sweet natured, playful and engaging girl, after her forever home. She is incredibly social, loves to follow you like a shadow and has great lead manners. For her age, Willow is either being lazy curled up sleeping or running around with her friends.

NAME: Summer
TEXT: *I am in a foster care home in Newtown in the inner west - reach out to the team to find out how I'm going!* The sun is shining - Summer is finally here! Well, Summer the greyhound that is! Summer is affectionate yet independent. She doesn’t mind spending time alone, making her a great fit for a variety of lifestyles. She has also spent time around children aged 3+ making her a great fit for families. Summer is a super social and friendly girl, making her perfect for those wanting an affectionate companion. She absolutely loves people, enjoys playtime, and settles beautifully inside. Summer is learning about the world and other dogs here at the centre and is doing so well! She would benefit from ongoing training for her dog sociability but is doing well at the centre. With the right family, Summer will thrive and make a wonderful companion. So grab your hat and sunnies and get ready to enjoy this ray of sunshine, available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Oakley
TEXT: Oakley is an energetic and fun loving greyhound, he thrives when given structured activities. His ideal owner will love all of his drive, energy and passion for all things fun. His best fit would be an owner who is eager to actively train and work with him. He is a driven hound driven who loves physical and mental stimulation. His perfect match will be someone looking for a highly trainable and driven dog who enjoys training as much as he does. He has a strong need for physical and mental stimulation. His recall is excellent, he performs 'down' on cue, and he has the ability to walk nicely in heel position after exercise. He loves the outdoors and would do best as an outside dog. He is available now from our Western Sydney centre.

NAME: Lilly
TEXT: Meet Lilly – A Sweet and Shy Greyhound! Lilly is a gentle and quiet female greyhound who may be a little shy at first, but once she gets to know you, her affectionate nature shines through. She’s great with all other dogs and would be sutiable for a home with a cat if you are patient and give her time to settle, making her an easy-going companion for any household. Lilly’s calm demeanor and low-key attitude make her the perfect choice for anyone looking for a laid-back, loving pet. Give her time to settle in, and she’ll reward you with endless loyalty and love!

NAME: Stacey
TEXT: Meet our sweet girl Stacey. Stacey warms up after a little bit of attention but initially she could be weary of her surroundings. She has spent time around children and is gentle around them. Stacey is responsive on lead but will like to sniff around as well.

NAME: Tracey
TEXT: Are you looking for the perfect all-arounder? Tracey will make for the perfect companion. Tracey has had frequent exposure to children and enjoys playing with them, she has also met chickens and cows at her current home. Tracey is incredibly engaging and responsive on lead; she has a great personality willing to people please.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a good all round pet that is looking to bring joy to someone's home Jimmy has grown up in a farm style setting and is experienced around kids as young as 5 years of age. Jimmy is an active boy who walks very well on lead and would thrive with a daily walk before retiring to his bed for the night. Jimmy loves a cuddle and with extra training and love would be a great apartment dog. Unfortunately Jimmy is a single pet dog as he thrives by himself and isnt a big fan of sharing his family with other dogs off lead. Jimmy is still a gentle and loving boy who is looking for his perfect family

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Are you after a playful and cheeky friend? Benji is after his forever home! He is all things cheeky, confident and cunning. Benji is responsive on lead but some extra training wouldn't go astray. He loves a pat and to bound around a yard big or small, he would be suitable to live in a townhouse or villa and would in time be able to conquer stairs. Benji had an injury in 2023 which he has now recovered from but has a plate in his hock. If you're interested in learning more about Benji, please apply now.

NAME: Coco
TEXT: Coco is an old dog at heart despite being 3 years old Coco is a very good dog who is working on his recall training and is succeeding as he is a great learner. Coco would be the ideal pet for a backyard whether that be adopters who are retirees with no other pets or a young couple looking for a boy who doesn't mind going for a bit of adventure. Ideally Coco would suit fulltime working hours and also a backyard and has grown up around teenagers

NAME: Prince
TEXT: Prince is a friendly and well-mannered greyhound looking for his forever home. He’s fantastic around kids and settles well after initial excitement. He walks beautifully on a lead and has experience being around other dogs, including a small sausage dog for a short amount of time and a Labrador. Prince is an intelligent boy who will let you know when he needs something—whether it’s food or a toilet break—with a few attention barks. With a loving family and a little routine, he’ll make a wonderful companion. If you’re looking for a loyal and affectionate addition to your home, Prince might just be the perfect fit!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Confident, social and happy, are all great ways to describe Gazza. Gazza is social with other M-L breeds of dogs. Maaaate, he'd love to join Shazza, Bazza and Dazza on daily adventures! Gazza doesn't mind if those ankle-biters are in the home, either, more good old fun for him! Gazza would love to do his daily burn outs in the yard but will nap away on the porch once his few moments of fun are over. He's a sweet guy at heart who can't wait to find his crew! Grab a stubby and a meet Gazza at the local watering hole because this fair dinkum fella has a few yarns to tell! He can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dustin
TEXT: Dustin is a gentle hound who has a calm, non jumpy, laid back nature. He has spent some time in a home and the feedback is: "He has been perfect, slept through the night, no inside accidents, amazing on the lead, friendly to everyone he meets and does not seem bothered at all." Never too over the top and never boisterous, Dustin is a lovely hound. If you want an affectionate and gentle boy, keep reading! Dustin is excellent on the lead with no pulling. He plays nicely with other greyhounds, spending time in our office with other greyhounds to simulate a home environment. He has excelled with stairs, too. He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: King
TEXT: Meet King – A Playful and Friendly Greyhound! King is a 4 1/2-year-old male greyhound who is the perfect mix of fun and friendly! He’s an energetic and playful companion who loves to make new friends and enjoy exciting activities. Whether it’s running around, playing games, or splashing in the water, King is always up for some fun! This gentle and loving greyhound has a heart full of joy and a playful spirit that will keep you smiling. He’s not just fast on his feet – he also has a soft spot for water! Whether it’s swimming or playing in a sprinkler, King loves getting wet and cooling off on warm days. If you’re looking for a dog who’s friendly, fun, and full of energy, King might just be your perfect match! Medica

NAME: Aimee
TEXT: Meet Aimee! She’s a sweet 3 1/2-year-old female greyhound with a gentle and easy-going nature. Aimee loves being around women and gets along great with dogs of all sizes. She’s calm, quiet, and very cruisy – perfect for a relaxed home where she can just chill out and enjoy the good things in life. Whether it’s lounging on the couch or enjoying a leisurely walk, Aimee’s low-maintenance personality makes her a wonderful companion.

NAME: Jax (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Jax! This handsome boy is ready to find his forever home - Greeting you with a happy wagging tail and affectionate energy, Jax is sure to win over your heart in no time! Jax has had the pleasure of spending time with whippets, kids, and has been in a loving house setting, so he's already on his way to being well-versed in being a great family companion. Jax is looking for a forever family where he can offer endless affection and share his happy, friendly demeanour. If you're looking for a sweet companion to join your family, Jax might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Rib
TEXT: Rib is a bundle of joy wrapped in fur! This happy, loving boy is full of energy and loves to make new friends. Whether he’s zooming around with his signature grace or cuddling up for a good nap, Rib is always in a great mood and ready to share his affection. He’s the perfect companion for anyone looking for a sweet and playful buddy. Rib is still a young pup, so he’s eager to learn, explore, and enjoy life to the fullest! If you're looking for a fun-loving, gentle soul who will steal your heart, Rib might just be your new best friend. 💖🐕‍🦺 Rib has met small dogs and makes new friends easily. If you’re ready to meet a tail-wagging, sunshine-filled boy, Rib is here to spread the love! 🌟

NAME: Bo
TEXT: Bo is a laid-back, cruisy greyhound who knows how to enjoy the simple things in life. He's a quiet guy, who loves to relax and take things slow, but don’t let his calm nature fool you—he’s got a heart full of love to give! Great with small dogs, Bo is the perfect companion for furry friends of all sizes. He’s also cat-workable, meaning he could fit in well with a home that has feline family members too. If you’re looking for a chill and friendly greyhound who’s ready to take life one relaxed step at a time, Bo’s your guy!

NAME: Iris
TEXT: Meet Iris, your soon-to-be favorite furry friend! This sweet and easy-going pup is all set to bring joy and love into your life. With her playful spirit and gentle personality, Iris is the perfect addition to any warm and welcoming home. She absolutely thrives on companionship and loves soaking up all the attention she can get! Iris is wonderfully adaptable, fitting seamlessly into both bustling households and peaceful settings. Whether your home is filled with laughter and activity or a cozy, quiet retreat, she’ll feel right at home. If you’re searching for a loyal friend who will shower you with affection and sprinkle a little extra happiness into your days, look no further—Iris is the one for you! Get ready for an amazing adventure with this lovely girl, who is sure to become a beloved member of your family.

NAME: Mo
TEXT: Gentle natured and affectionate, this senior boy will surely charm you with his adorable salt and pepper face. Mo has a lot of love to give and will share his affection with you from the moment you meet him. He has been around kids aged 1+ and would suit a home with kids who can respect his grandpa naps. Mo has shown wonderful manners with dogs big and small and is even learning about those so called "cats", too! We are hoping his forever home is full of soft beds, sunshine naps and treats...Maybe that could be you! Mo is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Angus
TEXT: Meet Angus, the sweet and happy greyhound who’s ready to find his forever home! He’s a gentle boy who requires his boundaries are respected. He also has some in-home experience. Angus would suit a home with a backyard/townhouse with a place to snooze without being bothered, and is happy to spend the day independently while you're gone, a long as he gets a few walks and some playtime. Angus is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Coral
TEXT: Meet Coral, the gentle and affectionate dog looking to become a cherished member of your family. Coral is currently living with an elderly small dog, showcasing her ability to adapt and coexist harmoniously with other pets. Coral is the epitome of calmness, making her a great match for those who appreciate tranquil moments alongside their furry companions. If you are seeking a loyal friend who will bring comfort and joy to your home, Coral is the perfect match. Embrace the opportunity to create lasting memories with this delightful, easygoing lady.

NAME: Tay Tay
TEXT: Meet Tay Tay, a delightful bundle of happiness wrapped in fur! This friendly and playful girl is ready to bring her infectious joy and wagging tail into a loving home. Tay Tay enjoys being both indoors and outdoors, and when she's inside, her good manners truly shine. With her playful spirit, she would be an excellent fit for a home with a bit of space to romp around, though she's equally content curling up with you for some downtime. If you're seeking a loyal and happy-go-lucky companion who's as comfortable playing as she is lounging by your side, Tay Tay is your girl.

NAME: Soy
TEXT: Meet Soy, the joyful canine companion who embodies the essence of youthful exuberance. Soy is young at heart and greets each day with an infectious sense of playfulness that will make your heart swell with joy. Soy's happy-go-lucky personality is perfect for anyone looking to bring energy and fun into their home. His playful spirit will have you rediscovering the joy in life's simplest pleasures, from playing in the backyard to leisurely walks around the neighborhood. Whether he's catching a ball or simply lounging by your side, Soy revels in the company of his human friends, showcasing his loyalty and affection in delightful ways.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a cheerful and easy-going canine with a heart full of fun. His positive attitude is contagious, and he never fails to bring a smile to the faces of everyone he meets. Bob is the perfect blend of laid-back and playful, making him a versatile companion for various lifestyles. Whether you're seeking a buddy for leisurely walks in the park or a great companion for some backyard fun, Bob is your guy. When it comes to spreading happiness, Bob is a natural. His enthusiasm for life shines through in all he does, from simple lounging around with his favorite humans to exciting games of fetch or tug-of-war. If you're ready for endless moments of laughter and a devoted friend who delights in life's simple pleasures, Bob might just be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Newt
TEXT: Newt is an older boy who loves cuddles, pats and brushes and other simple joys of life - toys, bones and sleeping! He will walk around all day with a bone in his mouth if he can. He is great to walk on the lead, no pulling, and is great with the nephews and nieces 7 and 10 years who come over regularly. He is very gentle with them and loves their company. He loves meeting new people and is good with other dogs. Newt would love to find his forever home to rest on a soft rug or bed and be near your side, sleeping happily. He hasn't had an indoor life but is very clean in his kennels and wouldn't take long to learn to let you know he needs to go out. This gentleman would be perfect as a companion for a quiet household, he would love attention and affection, some basking in the sun and a walk around the yard or even around the block or to the local park for pats and admiration and, of course, a bone! Just He doesn't mind a car ride either. 💙

NAME: Paton
TEXT: Meet Paton, a gentle soul with a heart full of love waiting to be shared. While he may initially appear shy, give him a little time, and you'll discover a warm, affectionate side eager to form a deep bond. Paton flourishes when offered a nurturing environment where patience and kindness are the norms. Once you get to know him, you'll be rewarded with unwavering loyalty and affection. Beyond his loving demeanor, Paton enjoys every moment spent with his humans and takes particular delight in quiet moments together. For those seeking a companion with a nurturing and gentle personality, Paton is ready to fill your days with warmth and love. All he needs is a caring family to call his own.

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: Meet Alfie, the lovable canine with a heart as big as his playful nature. Alfie is known for his boundless friendliness, making him an excellent companion for anyone seeking a playful, affectionate dog. Alfie enjoys nothing more than a good play session with medium to large breed friends. His playful energy is a perfect match for an active lifestyle, where he can gallop, jump, and frolic with fellow dog buddies, spreading joy and making friends easily. Consider Alfie if you're looking for an engaging and social pet to add to your family. With the right blend of companionship and play, Alfie will undoubtedly bring endless smiles and tail wags to your life.

NAME: Ben
TEXT: Meet Ben, a cheerful and playful canine who radiates happiness wherever he goes. With his friendly nature, Ben has a knack for making anyone feel welcome and loved. Ben thrives on interaction and loves being part of lively households where he can engage in playful activities and spread his joy. This loveable pup's friendly personality makes him an excellent companion for families seeking a four-legged friend who is happy to be part of their daily adventures. If you're looking for a dog who encapsulates happiness and loyalty in one furry package, Ben could be the perfect addition to your family!

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Meet Jimmy, a laid-back and easygoing dog with a heart full of love to give. Jimmy is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a relaxed and unflustered canine friend. Jimmy is dog who adores the simple pleasures in life, from leisurely strolls in the park to quiet evenings lounging at home. He's not one to rush through life but rather takes his time to soak in his surroundings, making every moment feel special and serene. His chilled-out nature also makes him an excellent companion for other medium to large breed dogs. If you're in search of a dog who can seamlessly integrate into a tranquil lifestyle, whether you're single, a couple, or a family, Jimmy is ready to settle in and share his companionship with you. Get ready for leisurely adventures and cozy evenings with this loving and relaxed furry friend.

NAME: Candy
TEXT: Meet Candy, an enchanting canine companion with a heart as sweet as her name. While it may take her a little time to get to know you, once she forms a bond, she transforms into the most devoted and joyful friend you could ever hope for. Candy is a social butterfly in the dog world, always happy to make new canine friends. Her water-loving nature adds an extra splash of fun to sunny outings, as she delights in playing by the water's edge or splashing around in a shallow pond or kiddie pool. Her ideal home would be one with other dogs that match her energy levels, which aren’t overwhelmingly high. A pool for her to frolic in would be an added bonus, though she's just as thrilled with a simple garden hose spray or a splash through a stream during her walks. With Candy by your side, you're sure to enjoy a relationship that's as rewarding as it is heartwarming.

NAME: Cobalt
TEXT: **Cobalt is currently in a foster home, reach out to the team for info! He has even been friendly with free ranging pet chickens!** Cobalt foster update: He would prefer to have access to inside and outside the house during the day especially when you are not home. He sleeps right throughout the night and snoozes most of the day. He loves going for walks and knows how to communicate it to you by getting your attention and pointing his nose to his leash. His doing well with our chickens provided that they are behind the fence. When we do let the chickens out he is well behaved on his leash. He is a very gentle sweet boy that loves hugs, pats and praises. He is not highly motivated with food more on praises and pats. He loves playing with his squeeky toy and loves playing fetch. He is still yet to learn how to give the ball back though. Cobalt is a super affectionate and cuddly companion who can't wait to begin spending time with his new family and can be suited to a household with full time workers. This cheerful boy has shown to be very polite with other medium/large breed dogs and is open to sharing his new home with another dog friend. A backyard would be amazing so he can have somewhere to run around and play! Whether he's playing in the backyard or just enjoying a lazy afternoon, Cobalt brings joy wherever he goes!

NAME: Aggy
TEXT: Stunning Aggy! Gorgeous blue brindle colour. Aggy is sweet & gentle lady. She has the desire to explore & learn but at slower pace. Aggy needs patience, love & a quieter home to grow into the best version of herself. Aggy would do best in a home with part-time workers or another furry friend around to show her the ropes.

NAME: Paddy
TEXT: Mr Paddy! This gentle giant is such an easy-going, laid-back goof ball! He is always down to clown or just take it easy and rest his feet. He gets on well with smaller breeds of dogs- there's a Yorkie always saying hello :) Paddy interacts positively with new people, even younger children. He would love to have yard where he can run about, chasing toys thrown by his new best friends :)

NAME: Skip
TEXT: Meet Skip, the happy and friendly boy. This loyal and loving dog is always ready to greet you warmly and share a moment, no matter how small. Not only does Skip adore people, but he's also a social butterfly with other dogs, making him an incredible addition to multi-dog households. This charming canine companion will enrich your life with his unwavering loyalty and snuggles. Whether it’s a hike through the woods or a cozy night at home, Skip is just happy to be by your side, providing companionship, laughter, and unconditional love. If you're looking for a furry friend who always wears a smile and offers boundless affection, Skip might just be the perfect companion for your household.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Affectionate, sweet and resilient are the first words that come to mind to describe Missy. She is special in more ways then one, with a huge heart and a courageous mentality she is also a tri paw having had a back leg amputation at the thigh but she doesn't let that stop her zooming around the yard or going for walks with the family. Missy plays well with other dogs but dosent appreciate being barked at or jumped on so a respectful friend is welcomed but she is also fine being alone. Missy absolutely adores children, she’s been in foster with an 8 yo girl and loves nothing more than a cuddle from any human! She is crate trained, clean and quite to add to the list of great things about Missy! Get in touch for a meet and greet with Missy to see how fantastic she is for yourself, We hope to meet you soon 😍

NAME: Scout
TEXT: Meet Scout, a gentle soul of a dog. Scout is an easy-going companion, ready to fill your days with quiet affection and steadfast loyalty. His presence is soothing and his love is unconditional, offering the perfect balance in a fast-paced world. Scout's relaxed nature makes him the ideal partner for leisurely walks around the neighborhood or peaceful afternoons spent lounging in the backyard. He's more than content to curl up at your feet, providing the kind of quiet companionship that warms the heart. Scout would like a quiet home where is gets lots of love and affection. Scout has met cats and would settle with proper introduction and a calm easy going cat.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear, the ultimate embodiment of relaxation and tranquility wrapped up in a big, huggable package. This calm and easygoing canine companion resembles a giant teddy bear. Bear's favourite pastime is napping. Whether it's a lazy afternoon snooze on the patio or stretching out for a long, cozy rest beside you on the couch, Bear knows how to unwind like no other. While he might not be the most active pup on the block, Bear’s delightful charm lies in his serene nature. He's the perfect partner for a quiet afternoon reading session or watching a movie at home. Bear also enjoys a short walk around the block where he can have a sniff and explore Bear would thrive in a home where he can enjoy a relaxed lifestyle. While he may be big in size, his heart and loveable nature are even bigger.

NAME: King
TEXT: Introducing King, a regal canine companion who effortlessly lives up to his name with friendliness and charm. This amiable boy is known for his warm demeanor and ability to get along with both humans and his fellow canine friends. King has been crate trained and upholds pristine manners indoors, demonstrating his adaptiveness and intelligence. His crate is a cozy and secure retreat where he feels right at home. King appreciates having a structured, comfortable space that provides him with a sense of stability. King's sociable personality extends to all dogs, and he thrives on the companionship and joy of his furry peers. If you’re seeking a friendly, sociable, and well-mannered dog to be a part of your family or home, King is ready for royal treatment and a happy, loving environment King in the boy for you

NAME: Goldie
TEXT: Meet Goldie, an affectionate and playful canine companion ready to bring sunshine into your life. Goldie thrives in environments where she can interact and play with both people and other pets. Her playful spirit never goes unnoticed, as she's always eager to chase after a ball or tug at her favorite toy. Her warm eyes and wagging tail greet you at the door, welcoming you with endless affection and enthusiasm.

NAME: Brinnie
TEXT: Meet Brinnie, a friendly boy wrapped up in a furry package! This delightful dog is on the hunt for a loving home, and he's ready to bring joy and companionship to your life. Brinnie is the definition of easygoing. He gets along splendidly with other dogs, making him a wonderful addition if you already have a canine companion or you're considering expanding your furry family. Brinnie's laid-back personality means he adapts well to various environments. He's content to enjoy some downtime with you or find a sunny spot for a relaxing nap. Equally, he'll never turn down a walk around the neighbourhood or a play date with furry friends. Whether you're a family looking for a reliable companion or an individual searching for a fuss-free friend, Brinnie's undeniable charm and friendly nature make him the ideal choice.

NAME: Arnie
TEXT: A true superstar, introducing Arnie! With a name like Arnie, it’s no surprise this guy is ready to bring some action into your life. He’s ready to run into your heart faster than a speeding chopper! If you’ve ever watched Arnie in Predator, you know that underneath that tough exterior is a soft spot that only the right person can unlock. Arnie is no different! With a calm and loving nature, he’ll cuddle up with you after a long day of zoomies, providing the perfect balance of strength and sweetness. Arnie is ready to join your family and take the "I’ll be back" to a whole new level. If you're ready to bring Arnie into your life and experience a life of creating your own highlight reel...contact GAP. Arnie is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre...let the adventures begin!

NAME: Ron
TEXT: Ron is a calm, affectionate, and super people-friendly boy looking for his perfect forever home! This sweet boy is gentle, independent and well suited to hours alone in an indoor/apartment setting. Ron has spent time around children aged 7 and older and is wonderful with them, making him an excellent family companion. He also gets along well with the other greyhounds and so could do well in a home with other medium/large size dogs. Ron enjoys his down time and is quite low maintenance, enjoying his alone times in our office. If you’re looking for a gentle and loving hound to add to your home, Ron might just be your perfect match! Come meet Ron today and let his loving nature steal your heart!

NAME: Dora
TEXT: Pleased to introduce you to the wonderful Dora! Dora is a senior lady looking to share her love with a new family. Dora has spent time living with a young family for approx 12 months & is now ready to find her forever home. She loves young children. Very patient & calm with them. Dora is gentle, kind & affectionate. Engaging in sweet cuddles & kisses. Dora may adapt to living on her own or in an apartment. Confident & content, she might well adapt to full-time workers as well :)

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Blue (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hey, I’m Blue! A lovable greyhound with a heart as big as my long legs. If you’re looking for a dog who adores butt scratches, enjoys good company, and knows how to chill, I might just be your perfect match. I get along great with other dogs and don’t mind spending time in the yard while you’re out – but I do love having the freedom to go in and out as I please. I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and take in the fresh air throughout the day. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. When I first started walking, I wasn’t sure what to do, but with some patience and encouragement, I’ve learned to keep going and haven’t had any issues in a long time! Now, I just take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in, - but I thrive best in a home where I still get plenty of interaction throughout the day. I love being around my people and enjoy a good balance of companionship and independence. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. So, if you’re hoping for blue sky forecasts for the rest of your life! Come and meet Blue, its sure to cure your blues!

NAME: Zali
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Zali! 💗 Zali is a super sweet, soft-natured little lady with a heart full of kindness. 🐶 As a very petite female greyhound, she’s looking for a quiet, loving home—ideally with a calm canine friend by her side. She’s grown up around kind teenage kids who absolutely adore her. While a little shy at first, with gentle encouragement, Zali will soon bring you a toy to play with and melt your heart. 💕 If you're after a gentle soul to share quiet moments and sweet companionship, Zali is your girl.

NAME: Joy
TEXT: Let us introduce JOY! and what a Joy she is! Joy brings out the best in us all. She is full of happiness, kindness & love. Joy is a senior lady but in no way does that slow her down. She is confident, engaging & playful. She loves to explore & is eager to learn. Joy has grown up with smaller breeds of dogs, chickens, ducks & sheep around. If you're searching for two lovely ladies to join your family, Joy's sister Boss, is also available :)

NAME: Vixen
TEXT: Meet Vixen, a spunky and joyful girl who’s ready to find her forever home! With her excitable energy and sweet cuddly nature, Vixen is the type of dog who’ll brighten anyone's day! While she’s got a ton of enthusiasm and excitement to share with her people, she’d be happiest as your one and only pup — so she can enjoy having all the attention to herself! Given the time and patience to adjust to her new routine, Vixen will quickly learn how to be the best companion and show you what an amazing pet she can be! If you’re looking for a loving & gentle girl with lots of personality and a zest for life, Vixen just might be your perfect match.

NAME: Banks
TEXT: This friendly boy loves his toys and loves spending time with other dogs (and is also learning that small dogs are friends!) Banks could suit a home with a courtyard/townhouse and kids who enjoy fun, adventures and playtime! He settles well alone or with a doggie pal. Banks is a brand new face here at the centre so watch this space for more updates! Banks is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Woody
TEXT: Woody is looking for a home with a canine companion or someone home all the time. He has lived in foster care with 2 other hounds and can be left for full time hours with a doggie pal. --- My foster carers call me smoochy, cuddly, quirky, smart & obedient. I love people, I'm so excited for everyone to pat me! My foster carers tell me I'm a special "blue fawn" colour which is apparently quite rare! My foster family go away for full time work & I'm totally blasé about it with my 2 doggie pals next to me. I'm a lazy bones but happy for a daily stroll where I promise to walk perfectly on the lead. I'm ready to share my multi-dog home life experience, tried and tested pet skills & affectionate nature with you! Come meet Woody today and discover the love that only a senior greyhound can offer. **Woody is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info** *Woody has spent months in foster care with 2 greyhound buddies, one male one female - contact the Western Sydney team to meet him*

NAME: Friday
TEXT: *Friday is in a foster care unit apartment & is available to adopt - reach out to the team for more info!* Foster Care Update: Friday is such an incredibly loving and sweet boy. He loves neck and under chin scratches. He is very playful in the mornings but loves a good snooze on the couch and knows how to be calm in his bed during naps and the evening. He sleeps throughout the night with no inside accidents or barking/winning. He is a bit scared of unfamiliar noises such as trains, cars on the street and working on stairs with these noises. When outside he doesn't exhibit interest in small animals or birds. -------- Friday would suit a home with stair access. He enjoys being indoors, sunbaking with a mix of couch naps. Friday shows nice calm behaviours with a mix of playful and silly, making him a perfect addition to many home types. Respectful children would enjoy his gentle energy. He could live with another greyhound, too. Come and meet Friday at the Western Sydney adoption centre along with his dedicated foster carer!

NAME: Azzie
TEXT: Great with young children. Happy go lucky guy. Calm, friendly & sweet natured. Good with smaller breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle would be best. If you might consider welcoming two greyhounds into your home, Azi’s brother Arrie is also searching for his forever home :)

NAME: Arthur
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Arthur! 🐻‍❄️ Arthur is a relaxed, easygoing gentleman who’s all about the simple things in life. 💤 He’s a dream on the lead and enjoys peaceful walks at a gentle pace. This gentle soul has grown up around young children and gets along well with larger dog breeds. While he prefers a quieter lifestyle, he’s not without his playful side—he loves his fluffy toys! 🧸💕 If you’re after a laid-back buddy with a big heart, Arthur might be your perfect match.

NAME: Harley
TEXT: Meet Harley, a cheerful and easygoing companion. This friendly fella has a personality that's as warm as the summer sun, making him an ideal addition to any family seeking a loyal, loving dog. Harley has a delightful, laid-back nature about him. He is effortlessly sociable, having met small dogs with a friendly yet disinterested attitude, ready to just hang out and enjoy their company without demanding constant interaction. With his infectious happiness and calm, affectionate personality, Harley promises to be a wonderful companion for anyone seeking a peaceful, friendly presence in their life. If you’re ready to welcome an easygoing and friendly buddy into your life, Harley is more than ready to meet you.

NAME: Johnny
TEXT: Meet Johnny, a quiet and friendly companion who's ready to fill your home with love and warmth. Johnnie's easygoing nature ensures that he'll easily fit into your daily routine without much fuss. Johnny gets along well with other dogs, and his amiable attitude makes him a great candidate for multi-pet households. He's particularly suited for a laid-back lifestyle, where he can enjoy peaceful moments by your side or spend time playing friends. Whether it's a leisurely walk around the neighborhood or relaxing at home Johnny is keen to be involved Johnny is the perfect fit for a family or individual seeking a loyal and tranquil companion.

NAME: Alice
TEXT: Say hello to Alice, a cheerful and friendly canine companion whose sunny disposition will warm your heart! Her enthusiasm and easygoing nature make every day feel like an adventure. She gets along wonderfully with small dogs, and her friendly attitude extends to cats as well—she's met them and remained perfectly composed. So with the right cat Alice will fit in perfectly. Adopt Alice and watch as every day becomes brighter with her delightful smile and warm, inviting personality.

NAME: Storm
TEXT: Relaxed & very loving older lady. Has spent time around grandchiildren. Storm is a confident girl looking for a life of leisure. She will do well on her own, with full time workers..... or if you might consider welcoming 2 beautiful ladies into your life, Storm’s sister, Chucky is also available :)

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Rissole
TEXT: Rissole is a handsome blue boy. Described as a happy, cheerful bubbly boy, we think he could live with older kids and would be content with a courtyard or backyard to call his own. He can be shy when you first get to know him, so a home who enjoy bringing a dog out of their shell will be the best fit for this pretty boy. We have noticed he is more confident around other hounds, and would suit a home with another doggie pal, but not a requirement. He is looking for a quiet loving home - could it be you? Rissole is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Yep, Astro is astronomically cute! This gorgeous boy is looking for a quiet backyard, with or without a dog, he's even friendly with small dogs! What a polite and lovely boy....read on to learn more! This sweet boy is currently learning our stairs, to gain his stair licence, one step at a time. He is best suited for shorter hours with or without a doggie pal while he learns to settle in. He's also learning to be friends with cats - watch this space! A backyard with indoor outdoor access and a quiet home who can nurture Astro into the best pet will be the best match for him. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Buzz
TEXT: **I'm currently in a foster home, a unit apartment in the city - Reach out to GAP for more info!* Foster Care Update! "We’ve been able to leave Buzz alone at home while we’ve been out for a few hours without any dramas. He continues to be a very people-loving dog who charms everyone he meets on his walks and loves attention." "He is very confident with people, he is very sweet and affectionate and loves greeting new people (and they love him). From the start he was always coming up to us for pets and cuddles. He has been very good at learning how to go down the steps slowly and carefully. He has been very good when we leave the house. And he doesn’t cry at night either, he’s perfectly happy in his bed until we come out to take him on his morning walk. He loves walking, but he can only walk for 10-15 minutes or less before becoming quite tired due to the extra exertion of walking on three legs. Which makes him a very low maintenance dog! He really only needs a short morning and evening walk/toilet break, maybe some exercise in the backyard at lunch (he loves playing fetch with his soft toys). Otherwise he’s very happy to snooze the day away. Another great thing is that he loves his food but has no interest in human food - Buzz is perfectly happy lying down next to us when we eat. He’s very well toilet trained, no accidents inside." ------ While I am incredibly confident with being out and about and using stairs, a ground floor home is best. I also love small children, however also love licking faces and can have a bit of energy, so older children are preferable to share my home with. I am also A-M-A-Z-I-N-G with training! I know “bed”, my name, “down” and my recall is un-bee-lievable. I would love to bee friends with other dogs of a medium/large size and would happily share my hive with them. So don’t bee a stranger, make a bee-line to the Western Sydney Adoption Centre to meet me today!

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: *I am in a foster care home - reach out to the team to meet me!* Foster Update - "What a lovely natured pup! He's settled in really well. Loves to play with his toys and loves sitting at the window watching everything that goes on in the neighbourhood. We all love Lenny! His main position is upside down on his back!" I like other greyhounds and happy to live with one but I don't need one in my forever home. I seem to do well on my own, enjoying the independence and time to ponder, and could suit longer hours alone with some practice. I don't mind a crate but it's not essential in my forever home. If you've got a comfortable couch for an adorable wise old man like me, please apply! PS...I cross my legs politely when I lie down. I consider myself quite the fancy boy! I'm a super special lad, please meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Arthur
TEXT: And I say HEY! What a wonderful kind of day. If you can learn to work and play and get along with Arthur the greyhound! Arthur is a total cutie pie. He is the star of the show, much like the 90's show! Arthur would enjoy a home without another canine companion, and would prefer his family members to be older children or adults only. He is super polite with other hounds but doesn't need their companionship, so being a solo pet is best for this independent boy. He is a shy boy at heart, but loves smooches and cuddles once you get to know him. A backyard or courtyard would be preferred while he learns the ins and outs of pet life. He can even do stairs, walking on a loose lead, as well as learning some training cues like 'on your bed' and 'off your bed'... Talk about talented! It's a simple message and it comes from the heart, Believe in this (and in Arthur the greyhound) for that's the place to start! Arthur is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Nacho
TEXT: Taco bout cute! We don't want to make it too cheesy, but in between napping and playtime, we think Nacho's got what it takes to salsa into your life like he's always been there. He doesn't mind if you go out for a few hours, making him suitable for those who are out of the house for long periods, as long as he has backyard access. Nacho’s perfect home is one where he gets daily playtime and enrichment as he does enjoy having fun! Opaque fencing in his backyard will help him thrive! He would also love to spend his days with another greyhound or M-L doggie friend. He is affectionate, friendly and snuggly too. He's learnt a bunch of tricks at the centre like how to do stairs, learning to do 'down' and even shake! Older kids with dog experience would be a great match. He’s looking for a family who can appreciate a dog with a zest for life (and cheesy puns...) Nacho is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. All you have to do is bring the love (and maybe some chips).

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet the one and only Missy. An absolute delight in all aspects of her being, she is extremely playful and still has puppy tendencies, which is why we have said she would suit older children as she doesn't quite know her size. Missy loves to engage for pats and throwing a toy for her but would like to have time to herself and have it respected in her new home. Due to Missy's age she may find adjusting to a new home a little bit hard but she has the confidence to grow and develop if her new parents are interested.

NAME: Cookie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Cookie is a friendly & social girl looking for her new home where she will be surrounded by love and attention! She’s very human-focused and loves being around people, always displaying positive consent and gentle affection. Whether it’s playtime or cuddle time, she’s sure to brighten your day! Cookie does very well walking calmly on a lead, making walks a relaxed and enjoyable experience. She’s also shown to be good around our other greyhounds, and could be happy sharing her new home with another medium/large doggie friend - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Western Sydney site. Contact us today to learn more about this lovely girl and discuss booking in an appointment to meet her!

NAME: Wynstan
TEXT: Wynstan with a Y here...let me tell you a bit about myself! I hope you like a happy affectionate boy, if so, read on! I love to lean on my handlers and show off my adorable affectionate nature. Did anyone tell you I'm also polite with big and small dogs? Seriously, I'm a catch! I'm also all about my treats, so if you're looking to teach me tricks, please involve snacks too! This will help me settle in and learn how to be the best pet for you. Everyone says I'm amazing, so I guess they love how I walk so nicely and gently on the lead for walkies, too! I'm available from the Western Sydney adoption centre, see you soon!

NAME: Millie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi I'm Millie! I'm a friendly, happy girl who loves to greet you with a big smile. I'm an affectionate girl who promises to walk nicely on the lead for our daily adventures, making me a great fit for families or couples looking for an adventure buddy. I don't mind if you have respectful children or other larger breed dogs at home, as I've shown I'm a friend to greyhounds here. I'm ideally looking for a home with a bit of a townhouse or backyard, but I promise to be by your side for snuggles at night. I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Matey
TEXT: Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and happy go lucky energy, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! Matey has spent some time in a foster care home and we have learnt he loves spending time with his family and going for a quiet sniffari around the block! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a playful companion and would do best in a home without young kids or other pets. Matey suits part-time or full-time workers provided he lives in a quiet area with opaque fencing so he can just relax and snooze the day away in the backyard. Get ready to meet your new best Matey! This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Paul
TEXT: Paul is a stunning boy who is great to play with, can be left alone. He is social and confident with other dogs and a good walker on the lead.

NAME: Andy
TEXT: Andy is a lovely boy, he is very confident and obedient. Knows his name and is good to walk on the lead. Has had exposure to various native animals living in a rural area.

NAME: Faye
TEXT: *I am in a foster care home in Sydney - reach out to the team to meet me!* This adorable and gentle girl is looking for fun loving home to call her own! Faye is an adorable girl who is friendly with people she meets. Maybe you're retired, work from home or live a chilled life, as she prefers someone around more often than not. Faye wouldn't mind living in a unit apartment & she would enjoy a home where she is going to be a beloved family member. Faye would suit a home with another likeminded greyhound or respectful children. Sweet little Faye is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is currently in a foster home with his sister Katie. We have loved getting to know Ace and giving him the opportunity to enjoy his new life as a pet. Affectionally known to us as our ‘Sookie Lala’, Ace just wants to be by your side 24/7. He loves being close and seeing what things you are getting up to throughout your day. He also loves the outdoor (and indoor) couch and will happily settle in there for the day when outside. Ace will bounce happily on his toes when we come home and loves a hug and cuddle. We are teaching him how to play fetch and he really enjoys being included in any play time activities. He is toilet trained and sleeps very well throughout the night. Ace walks wonderfully on a leash as he likes to be right by your side. He doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small and is very friendly to other small dogs and children. If you have love to give and are looking for a dog to soak it all in – Ace is your boy! ______________________________________________________________________________ Ace is a playful and gentle hound. He was very friendly and nice when he met my daughter and was good company with a good balance of being playful and affectionate. Gets along great with other greyhounds. Currently fostered in a suburban home and getting comfy coming inside the house and loving the backyard.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is currently in a foster home with her brother Ace. We have loved getting to know Katie and giving her the opportunity to enjoy her new life as a pet. Being the older sister, she is very independent and settles very easily. She is very happy to sit on her bed whilst you work or go about your day. She is toilet trained and has fallen into her new routine very easily. She gets so excited to see us, as exemplified with her happy, whipping tail (duck for cover!). She tends to jump up on you when she’s very excited, but this is something we are working on and have already seen great improvements on. Katie walks well on a leash and doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small. She has done well approaching small dogs and children and saying hello. Katie would be a great pet for a someone looking for an independent dog that will also shower you will love and affection. __________________________________________________________________________ Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals and is now in suburban foster care enjoying cuddly toys, living out the back and coming in the home for the evening.

NAME: Flash
TEXT: **I'm in a foster home** Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has advanced pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals. Flash would prefer a calm environment where he can be the only one getting your attention and affection. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Flash is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Alex
TEXT: Meet Alex, an incredibly fun and playful greyhound with a heart full of energy and charisma! He loves playing games with toys and is always up for a good fetch session. Alex would thrive in a home with a spacious backyard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. He’s suitable for living with other medium to large dogs and is especially fond of older kids who can keep up with his playful nature. Alex loves his food and is highly trainable and easy to entertain with enrichment activities. He walks lovely on lead and would make a great walking companion for a daily neighbourhood stroll. If you're looking for a joyful, active companion, Alex might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Daryl
TEXT: Daryl is a handsome and affectionate 5 year-old greyhound with plenty of love to give. He’s a playful and affectionate boy who adores attention and thrives on human companionship. While he gets excited during playtime and loves a run around the secured local oval he quickly settles down and walks beautifully on a lead. Derick has been socialised around other greyhounds as he lives in a home with his 2 best greyhound friends Daryl would make a fun and loving addition to any person looking for a loyal companion.

NAME: Joe
TEXT: Are you looking for a calm, mega chill, laid back boy to join your world? Maybe you've seen those amazing pet greyhounds out on walkies in the big wide world and thought you'd like your very own amazing boy? Well I'm laid back, confident, walk well with my head held high! I'm ready to meet you and show you how amazing I am! I'm relaxed, quiet, gentle, and laid back. I'm super friendly with other dogs including small dogs. I could totally suit a home with respectful children as I am a total love bug. I am available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Meet sweet & beautiful Chandler... Chandler is a gentle and polite male greyhound with a calm and relaxed demeanor. He’s a sweetheart who greets everyone warmly and enjoys a good snuggle, especially after a sunbath. Chandler has been around older kids and medium-sized dogs, and he gets along well with both. He’s also a joy to walk on a lead, making him the perfect companion for leisurely strolls. Whether lounging in the sun or curled up for some quiet time, Chandler is sure to bring a sense of calm and affection to any home.

NAME: Sting
TEXT: Get ready to feel the Sting of love from this handsome boy! With his confident personality and loving nature, Sting is ready to take on the world, whether it’s playing in the backyard or having a cuddle session. Sting would thrive with an owner who can match his energy and provide plenty of love and attention. He would be open to sharing his new home with another furry friend, pending a meet & greet with the GAP team. He also has the potential to work up to longer hours alone, but would like he family or another furry companion with him to help settle in the early stages. If you’re looking to welcome a dog who’s full of personality and ready to make your life even more exciting, Sting might be the one for you!

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Meet Benji, a sweet and excitable boy who’s looking for his perfect forever home! Despite Benji nearing his senior years, he'll still win your heart over with his playful antics and would love a home with a courtyard or backyard to spend his time playing and sunbaking in. Benji has been around children of all ages in his previous home and could do well in a household with experienced children who can appreciate his enthusiastic nature. If you're ready to welcome a loving, loyal friend into your life, Benji can’t wait to meet you and be a part of your family!

NAME: Banjo
TEXT: Banjo is a sweet boy who is very relaxed and comfortable. He does like to play, go for walks and enjoys a swim. He would suit multiple homes since he is so laid back and relaxed.

NAME: Jax
TEXT: Jax is a fun young hound who likes to play go for walks and enjoys a good rest afterwards. He lives in a suburban backyard and is conditioned to being left alone during full time work hours. He comes when called and enjoys a walk.

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Rusty, a lovable and energetic boy who is ready to find his forever home! Rusty is a friendly companion who has had a brief introduction to pet life in his previous home - spending some time indoors, being taken on public walks and also meeting new people, including children! His warm, golden fur is as soft as his heart, and he’ll quickly become your new best friend and would do well in a home where he can get plenty of attention, exercise, and affection. If you're looking for a dog who will bring joy to your life, Rusty might be the perfect fit. Come meet him today—he can’t wait to share his love with you!

NAME: Midas
TEXT: Gentle, calm and a lovely walking companion, Midas will add the glitz and gold to your life. Midas is an affectionate and gentle boy, who shines with attention and love. He would prefer his family around more this summer as he settles in, and with further training could be left for longer hours. Everything he touches will turn to gold...he is a friendly and calm boy looking for a family with or without children to love him forever! Midas is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billson
TEXT: Bubbly, effervescent and a perfect accompaniment for your life (not only this summer!), Billson is a sweet and joyful hound. He has been around children of all ages and would suit a home with respectful children. A low small dog population is the best fit for Billson as he needs to learn and have more training around them. Upbeat and fun, Billson would suit many home types. He's an energetic lad with some energy to fizz away, so a home with the family members around more often than not would be the best fit for Billson. Grab a slab and join Billson this summer! He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet Missy, a stunning female red fawn greyhound with a perfect balance of strength and sweetness. Missy can be strong on the lead, making her walks an exciting experience, but she is also incredibly relaxed and calm, adapting well to new environments and settling into a peaceful routine at home. Missy’s playful side shines through when it’s time for fun! She loves engaging with her humans, whether it’s a lively game or simply hanging out and soaking up attention. Her joyful and affectionate nature makes her a delightful companion for an active family or an individual who enjoys both adventure and relaxation. With her combination of strength, playfulness, and a laid-back attitude, Missy is ready to bring her warmth and energy into a loving home. If you’re looking for a dog who will keep you on your toes while also offering plenty of cuddles, Missy could be your perfect match!

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 6 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Jagger
TEXT: He’s got the moves like Jagger! This boy certainly knows how to impress! Jagger is a special boy with a personality that can melt your heart. Jagger has a laid-back and easy-going nature, making him suited a home that has a secure backyard/courtyard type environment. Jagger can adapt to a household where family members work full-time, as long as he receives the love and attention he deserves when they return home. Providing him with a comfortable space and engaging toys during the day can help keep him content. Due to his sweet nature, he is an ideal choice for a home with respectful children seeking a loving companion. He has shown to be polite with other medium to large canine companions. He is a social boy and enjoys the companion of his four-legged friends, if you have other dogs in the home, he will surely enjoy showing them his moves! Be sure to apply online today and mention Jagger’s name in your application, you don’t want to miss out on welcoming this loving, gentle and playful boy to your home.

NAME: Onyx
TEXT: Hey, I’m Onyx! I’m a fun-loving, playful Greyhound who’s all about adventure—especially when it comes to walkies and toys. I get super excited and might even do a little happy dance when I see the leash! After I’ve burned off some energy, though, I’m totally happy to settle down and be the best snuggle buddy ever. I’m great inside the house—no accidents here—and I promise I’m pretty low-maintenance when it comes to relaxing with you. Now, I do have one little request: I’m a one-pet kinda guy. I really prefer being the center of attention and soaking up all your love. Other pets? Not my thing. I just want to be your one and only, and trust me, I’ll make it worth your while! Oh, and about my voice—I’ve got a special talent. When I bark or howl, it sounds like an ambulance siren! It’s my way of letting you know when I’m excited or when I just want some attention. It’s quirky, and I think you’ll find it pretty hilarious once you hear it. If you’re looking for a goofy, affectionate companion who’ll keep you on your toes with zoomies and then curl up for some quality sleep time, I’m your guy. I can’t wait to find my forever home!

NAME: Disco
TEXT: Discos happy and playful energy makes her the perfect companion for a household ready to spend time playing and getting her walkies in. She will very quickly become your new best friend and would enjoy having people around more often in the early stages of being in her new home. Disco could also do well with another small or big dog friend. This happy girl would thrive in a home with less stimulation, she can live with a unit apartment life or a backyard.

NAME: Bert
TEXT: Bert is currently in a foster home and learning the ropes of pet life. Bert is ready to find his forever home, this boy has personality+, boasts confidence and loves to come along for pats and cuddles anytime he wants. Bert is social with other greyhounds and spends a lot of time relaxing or playing. He can still be a bit sporadic on lead and excitable but given his age with a the right training and time, he will adapt quickly. Bert would be suited to a house with a backyard so if he has any energy he can have a good explore and play around.

NAME: Costa
TEXT: Meet Cuddle Me Costa, a sweet and affectionate male greyhound who lives up to his name with big, warm cuddles! Costa is a confident, happy boy who loves to shower his family with love. He’s well-socialized with young children and medium-sized dogs, making him a perfect fit for family life. Costa is equally content doing his own thing or hanging out with the family, whether it’s relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet moment outdoors. With his loving nature and laid-back attitude, Costa is sure to bring joy and comfort to your home.

NAME: Rocky
